people.tiZh: Hey Clicky 创始人, Buildspace 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Hey Clicky and previously Buildspace, one of the largest online schools for people building their own ideas. He has made videos for over a decade, with posts regularly reaching millions of views.
people.bioZh: Hey Clicky 创始人, 此前创办 Buildspace——最大的在线创意建造学校之一。他做视频已超过十年, 作品常获数百万播放。

episodes.tEn: How to Actually Make Launch Videos That Convert

people.tiZh: Magic Patterns 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Alex Danilowicz is a front-end engineer and co-founder of Magic Patterns, one of the first teams building prompt-to-design tools in 2023. Magic Patterns helps product teams turn ideas into interactive, code-backed prototypes in minutes.
people.bioZh: 亚历克斯·丹尼洛维奇是一名前端工程师，也是 Magic Patterns 的联合创始人。该团队是 2023 年最早构建提示词生成设计工具的团队之一，帮助产品团队在几分钟内把想法变成可交互、带代码的原型。

episodes.tEn: How to Stand Out in an AI Design World: Inside Magic Patterns

people.tiZh: Moshi 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Moshi, building AI-powered recommendation and research tools for commodity traders. Background in mathematics and trading.
people.bioZh: Moshi 创始人兼 CEO，为大宗商品交易员打造 AI 推荐与研究工具。拥有数学与交易背景。

episodes.tEn: Building the Recommendation Engine for Commodity Traders

people.tiZh: Modal 首席执行官
people.bioEn: CEO and founder of Modal, a serverless cloud platform for AI compute. Previously CTO at Better and engineering leader at Spotify, where he built its recommendation system.
people.bioZh: Modal 首席执行官兼创始人，Modal 是面向 AI 计算的无服务器云平台。此前曾任 Better 首席技术官，并在 Spotify 担任工程负责人，主导构建其推荐系统。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Compute Comes in Rectangles: Erik Bernhardsson on Building Modal

people.tiZh: Mecka AI 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Mecka AI, which operates one of the largest robot data factories, building custom hardware and pipelines to collect egocentric human and robot data for training embodied models.
people.bioZh: Mecka AI 创始人兼 CEO，运营着规模最大的机器人数据工厂之一，通过自研硬件与数据管线采集第一人称人类数据和机器人数据，用于训练具身模型。

episodes.tEn: Inside the Robot Data Factory: Mecka's Josh Gao on Sensorizing Humans to Train Robots

people.tiZh: SF Compute 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of SF Compute, a marketplace and independent operator for buying and selling GPU compute capacity.
people.bioZh: SF Compute 联合创始人，该公司是 GPU 算力买卖的市场平台与独立运营商。

episodes.tEn: The Programmable Data Center: Evan Conrad of SF Compute

people.tiZh: Inflight 联合创始人、产品设计师
people.bioEn: Product designer and co-founder of Inflight, with design experience at Tinder, Facebook, and Airchat.
people.bioZh: 产品设计师、Inflight 联合创始人，曾在 Tinder、Facebook 和 Airchat 从事设计工作。

episodes.tEn: Designing Inflight: A Designer's Raw 0-to-1 Startup Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Emmanuel Ameisen is an interpretability researcher at Anthropic, studying how large language models like Claude form concepts and plan ahead. He previously worked in applied ML at Stripe and Insight and authored Building Machine Learning Powered Applications.
people.bioZh: Emmanuel Ameisen 是 Anthropic 的可解释性研究员，研究 Claude 等大语言模型如何形成概念、如何提前规划。他此前在 Stripe 和 Insight 从事应用机器学习工作，并著有《Building Machine Learning Powered Applications》。

episodes.tEn: Inside the Mind of AI: An Anthropic Researcher on How Models Really Work

people.tiZh: Metalab 设计总监
people.bioEn: Design Director at Metalab, where he builds internal AI tooling systems and custom AI tools for design teams.
people.bioZh: Metalab 设计总监，为设计团队构建内部 AI 工具系统与定制化 AI 工具。

episodes.tEn: Building Custom AI Design Tools at Metalab

people.tiZh: Dyna Robotics 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Jason Ma is co-founder and Chief Scientist at Dyna Robotics, where he works on world-action models and general-purpose robot learning from large-scale human video. His research focuses on robot learning, reinforcement learning, and physical AI systems deployed in real-world production.
people.bioZh: 马杰森是 Dyna Robotics 的联合创始人兼首席科学家，专注于世界-动作模型以及从大规模人类视频中学习通用机器人技能。他的研究聚焦于机器人学习、强化学习，以及部署到真实生产环境中的物理 AI 系统。

episodes.tEn: Robots That Predict the Future: Dyna-2 and Physical AI with Jason Ma

people.tiZh: Leash Bio 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Leash Bio, which builds DNA-encoded libraries and large-scale experimental datasets to train models that learn real chemistry. Works on turning wet-lab measurements into reinforcement-learning environments for drug-discovery agents.
people.bioZh: Leash Bio 联合创始人兼 CEO，通过 DNA 编码化合物库与大规模实验数据训练真正理解化学的模型，并致力于把湿实验测量转化为药物发现智能体的强化学习环境。

episodes.tEn: From Wet Lab to RL Env: 10,000 Drug-Discovery Campaigns in a Weekend — Ian Quigley, Leash Bio

people.tiZh: Google Labs 与 Gemini 应用副总裁
people.bioEn: Josh Woodward is the VP of Google Labs and head of the Gemini app and AI Studio. He has spent over 17 years at Google, overseeing its largest labs team behind products like NotebookLM, Project Genie, and Flow.
people.bioZh: 乔什·伍德沃德是 Google Labs 副总裁，负责 Gemini 应用与 AI Studio。他在 Google 工作超过 17 年，掌管其规模最大的实验室团队，主导了 NotebookLM、Project Genie 和 Flow 等产品。

episodes.tEn: Why Every Company Now Needs to Think and Operate Like a Lab Team

people.tiEn: President and Chief Product Officer, Cisco
people.tiZh: 思科总裁兼首席产品官
people.bioEn: Jeetu Patel is President and Chief Product Officer at Cisco, where he leads the company's product strategy and AI infrastructure efforts, including networking for GPU clusters and securing AI agents.
people.bioZh: 吉图·帕特尔是思科总裁兼首席产品官，负责公司产品战略与 AI 基础设施业务，包括面向 GPU 集群的网络与 AI 智能体的安全。

episodes.tEn: How Jeetu Patel Runs Cisco Like the World's Largest Startup

people.tiZh: Bending Spoons 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Luca Ferrari is co-founder and CEO of Bending Spoons, a software company that acquires and operates products such as Evernote, Vimeo, AOL and Airtable. He is known for running hiring and operations with a heavily data-driven, quantitative approach.
people.bioZh: 卢卡·法拉利是 Bending Spoons 的联合创始人兼 CEO，该公司收购并运营 Evernote、Vimeo、AOL、Airtable 等产品。他以高度数据驱动、量化的招聘与运营方式著称。

episodes.tEn: Luca Ferrari: The Operating System Behind Bending Spoons

people.tiZh: OpenAI Dots 产品负责人
people.bioEn: Alexander Embiricos leads product for Dots, OpenAI's always-on personal AI agents that act without waiting for a prompt, after previously leading Codex. He co-founded and ran the collaboration startup Multi, which OpenAI acquired in 2024.
people.bioZh: 亚历山大·恩比里科斯是 OpenAI Dots 的产品负责人——Dots 是无需等待指令就能主动帮用户做事的常驻个人 AI 智能体；此前他负责 Codex 产品。他曾联合创办协作软件公司 Multi 并任 CEO，该公司 2024 年被 OpenAI 收购。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Dots Lead on the Future of ChatGPT and Personal Agents

people.tiZh: Applied Compute 首席执行官；前 OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Yash Patil is the CEO of Applied Compute and a former OpenAI researcher who worked on Codex. He focuses on post-training, reinforcement learning, and the inference-serving stack for production AI systems.
people.bioZh: 亚什·帕蒂尔是 Applied Compute 的首席执行官，曾任 OpenAI 研究员并参与 Codex 项目。他专注于后训练、强化学习以及生产级 AI 系统的推理服务栈。

episodes.tEn: Applied Compute CEO Yash on the Limits of RL, the New AI Hyperscaler, and Why Post-Training Wins Inference

people.tiEn: Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure, Google
people.tiZh: 谷歌 AI 基础设施首席技术专家
people.bioEn: Amin Vahdat is Google's Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure, leading the design of TPU systems and large-scale datacenter infrastructure that power Google's frontier AI models. He works closely with DeepMind on hardware-software co-design for training and serving at hundred-thousand-accelerator scale.
people.bioZh: 阿明·瓦赫达特是谷歌 AI 基础设施首席技术专家，主导 TPU 系统与大规模数据中心基础设施的设计，为谷歌的前沿 AI 模型提供算力支撑。他与 DeepMind 紧密合作，围绕十万级加速器规模的训练与推理开展软硬件协同设计。

episodes.tEn: Google's AI Infrastructure Chief on the Physics and Economics of Frontier AI

people.tiZh: 谷歌搜索用户体验副总裁
people.bioEn: Rhiannon Bell is VP of UX for Google Search, leading design for AI-driven search experiences such as AI Mode at Google scale.
people.bioZh: 里安农·贝尔是谷歌搜索用户体验副总裁，负责领导 AI Mode 等 AI 驱动搜索体验的大规模设计工作。

episodes.tEn: How Google Designs for AI at Scale

people.tiEn: Head of ChatGPT & Codex (Core Products), OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI ChatGPT 与 Codex 负责人（核心产品）
people.bioEn: Thibault "Tibo" Sottiaux leads OpenAI's core products, spanning ChatGPT, Codex and the Dots personal-agent platform. A Belgian engineer, he previously worked on Google Maps and ML infrastructure at Google DeepMind, where he briefly led Gemini's human-data team before joining OpenAI in 2024 as an engineering lead for Codex.
people.bioZh: 蒂博·索蒂奥统管 OpenAI 核心产品线，覆盖 ChatGPT、Codex 以及 Dots 个人智能体平台。他是比利时工程师，曾在 Google 做 Google Maps，后在 Google DeepMind 负责机器学习基础设施并短暂领导 Gemini 人类数据团队，2024 年加入 OpenAI 任 Codex 工程负责人。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Tibo Sottiaux on Putting Humans at the Center of AI
Why Most Internet Actions Will Soon Be Taken by AI Agents

views.en: Build for a future where persistent learning agents, not manual loops, take most internet actions; human taste and empathy matter more than typing speed.
views.zh: 为这样一个未来而构建：持续学习的智能体、而非手工循环，将承担大多数互联网操作；人的品味与共情比打字速度更重要。

views.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; recursive self-improvement already happens under human supervision, and AGI may already be here.
views.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分而非障碍；递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生，AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来。

views.en: World models may not be necessary since generality could suffice; most code is now written by AI, and training-phase sandbox breaks are task-solving, not malice.
views.zh: 世界模型或许并非必需，通用性可能就足够；如今大部分代码由 AI 编写，训练阶段突破沙箱是任务求解而非恶意。

views.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave; eliminate model pickers and configuration fatigue rather than celebrate them.
views.zh: 共享经济与安全栈的开放生态将驱动下一波；应消除模型选择器与配置疲劳，而非推崇它们。

people.tiZh: 麻省理工学院博士研究员
people.bioEn: MIT PhD researcher working on Recursive Language Models, GPU kernels and KernelBench, and multi-agent systems. He studies how better harness design can unlock capabilities latent in existing models.
people.bioZh: 麻省理工学院博士研究员，研究递归语言模型、GPU 内核与 KernelBench，以及多智能体系统。他关注更好的 harness 设计如何释放现有模型中潜在的能力。

episodes.tEn: Recursive Language Models — Alex Zhang, MIT PhD

people.tiZh: 领导力教练，前谷歌/Facebook 高管
people.bioEn: Molly Graham spent over 20 years in leadership roles at Google, Facebook, Quip, and the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. She hosts TED's WorkLife podcast and runs Glue Club, a leadership community for senior operators.
people.bioZh: 莫莉·格雷厄姆在谷歌、Facebook、Quip 和 Chan Zuckerberg Initiative 担任领导职务超过 20 年。她主持 TED 的 WorkLife 播客，并运营面向资深运营者的领导力社区 Glue Club。

episodes.tEn: Molly Graham: The Grief, Burnout, and Opportunity Hiding Inside the AI Transition

people.tiZh: Decimals 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Danny Martinez is the CEO of Decimals, a platform focused on design hiring and talent. He has deep experience in design recruiting and building hiring processes for design teams.
people.bioZh: 丹尼·马丁内斯是 Decimals 的首席执行官，该平台专注于设计招聘与人才。他在设计招聘以及为设计团队搭建招聘流程方面拥有丰富经验。

episodes.tEn: Danny Martinez: Thriving in Today's Design Job Market

people.tiEn: Product & Engineering Lead, Computer Use, OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI Computer Use 产品与工程负责人
people.bioEn: Ari Weinstein leads product and engineering for Computer Use at OpenAI, working on agents that operate software end-to-end. He previously co-founded the automation app Workflow, which was acquired by Apple.
people.bioZh: 阿里·温斯坦是 OpenAI Computer Use 的产品与工程负责人，专注于让智能体端到端操作软件。他此前联合创办了自动化应用 Workflow，该公司后被苹果收购。

episodes.tEn: Inside OpenAI DevDay: Superhuman Computer Use, Decisions API, and the AI Cloud

people.tiZh: Legora 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Max Junestrand is the co-founder and CEO of Legora, an AI legal-tech company whose products are used by over 3% of the world's lawyers. He led Legora from launch in October 2024 to $100M ARR, one of the fastest-growing enterprise software companies.
people.bioZh: 马克斯·尤内斯特兰德是 AI 法律科技公司 Legora 的联合创始人兼 CEO，其产品被全球超过 3% 的律师使用。他带领 Legora 从 2024 年 10 月上线到实现 1 亿美元 ARR，成为全球增长最快的企业软件公司之一。

episodes.tEn: How a 27-Year-Old Built a $5.6B AI Company in 21 Months
Max Junestrand: The Willingness to Learn Faster Than Anyone Else

views.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning, and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
views.zh: 领域专长不如学习速度重要；押注模型自身的进步而非微调，并面向模型 3-6 个月后的能力来构建产品。

views.en: Scaling a company is a culture and hiring problem: recruit for growth potential, interview every senior hire, and make yourself redundant.
views.zh: 公司规模化本质是文化与招聘问题：按成长潜力招人、亲自面试每位高管，并主动让自己变得可被替代。

views.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one, so speed and iteration on customer feedback beat perfecting the product first.
views.zh: AI 正处于它最差的时刻，我们才跑到第一英里；因此快速迭代与客户反馈优先于先把产品打磨完美。

views.en: Legal AI needs a skilled driver, not vibe drafting; refusing to use AI in legal delivery is almost unethical, and demand is infinite.
views.zh: 法律 AI 需要熟练的驾驭者，而非凭感觉起草；在法律服务中拒绝使用 AI 几乎不道德，而需求本身是无限的。

people.tiEn: Professor of Machine Learning, University of Freiburg; ELLIS Institute Tübingen
people.tiZh: 弗莱堡大学机器学习教授；ELLIS 图宾根研究所
people.bioEn: The researcher most responsible for making AutoML a field of its own: Auto-WEKA, Auto-sklearn and Auto-PyTorch came out of his lab, as did the first book on AutoML and the AutoML conference he founded as general chair. Full professor at Freiburg since 2016, director of the ELLIS unit there and a Hector Endowed Fellow at the ELLIS Institute Tübingen, with three ERC grants. PhD and postdoc at UBC. His recent work argues that prior structure, not more data, is what tabular and scientific models are still missing — the thesis behind TabPFN.
people.bioZh: 把 AutoML 做成一个独立领域的人：Auto-WEKA、Auto-sklearn、Auto-PyTorch 都出自他的实验室，第一本 AutoML 专著和 AutoML 会议也是他牵头。2016 年起任弗莱堡大学机器学习正教授，兼该校 ELLIS 分部主任、ELLIS 图宾根研究所 Hector 冠名研究员，持有三项 ERC 基金。博士与博士后均在英属哥伦比亚大学。近年他主张表格与科学建模缺的不是更多数据而是先验结构，这正是 TabPFN 背后的论点。

episodes.tEn: TabPFN: The AI That Replaces Hours of Model Tuning for Tabular Data

people.tiZh: Replit 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Born in Jordan, moved to the US to work on developer tools at Codecademy and then Facebook, and founded Replit in 2016 on the idea that a browser tab should be enough to write and ship software. Replit Agent (2024) turned that into agentic coding, and Agent 4 will build a startup from a plain-English description. A $400M Series D led by Georgian in March 2026 tripled the company to a $9B valuation on more than 50 million registered users, with Masad targeting $1B ARR by year end. Outspoken about education: his argument is that young people should learn to direct machines rather than compete with them.
people.bioZh: 生于约旦，赴美先后在 Codecademy 和 Facebook 做开发者工具，2016 年创办 Replit，押的是「一个浏览器标签页就该够写完并发布软件」。2024 年的 Replit Agent 把这件事推到智能体编程，Agent 4 能从一句大白话描述直接搭出一家初创公司的产品。2026 年 3 月 Georgian 领投 4 亿美元 D 轮，估值翻三倍到 90 亿美元，注册用户超 5000 万，他的目标是年底 10 亿美元年化收入。他在教育话题上直言不讳：年轻人该学的是指挥机器，而不是跟机器竞争。

episodes.tEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad on AI Doom, Software, and Vibe-Coding
Why Specialized AI Could Beat the God Model
Replit CEO Amjad Masad: What Young People Should Learn in the AI Era

views.en: Young people should learn to question deeply held beliefs, not follow rigid syllabi; AI enables interest-driven, project-based learning.
views.zh: 年轻人应学会质疑根深蒂固的信念，而不是遵循僵化的教学大纲；AI 让兴趣驱动、项目式的学习成为可能。

views.en: AI makes software creation accessible to everyone; tokens complement human capital, but coders are still needed to understand systems and debug.
views.zh: AI 让软件创造对所有人开放；token 补充而非取代人力资本，但仍需要程序员理解系统、排查深层问题。

views.en: Specialized decision models beat general agents on control, cost and safety; companies must own their intelligence and avoid vendor lock-in.
views.zh: 专用决策模型在可控性、成本与安全性上胜过通用智能体；企业必须拥有自己的智能，避免被供应商锁定。

views.en: Smarter models may not become more aligned; they could get better at deception and reward hacking, so alignment evals may not predict real behavior.
views.zh: 更聪明的模型未必更对齐；它们可能更擅长欺骗与奖励黑客，因此对齐评估未必能预测真实行为。

views.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up commercial language; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone, yet agents still need liability for rogue actions.
views.zh: AI 末日论是包装过的商业话术；没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人，但智能体的越界行为仍需追责。

people.tiEn: Founder, Recursive; former Chief Scientist, Salesforce
people.tiZh: Recursive 创始人;Salesforce 前首席科学家
people.bioEn: Richard Socher is an NLP researcher who pioneered early neural approaches to general-purpose language understanding and served as Chief Scientist at Salesforce. He is now founder of Recursive, working on AI systems that automate AI research itself.
people.bioZh: 理查德·索赫尔是 NLP 研究者,早期推动了通用语言理解的神经方法,曾任 Salesforce 首席科学家。他目前创立 Recursive,致力于让 AI 系统自动完成 AI 研究本身。

episodes.tEn: Recursive Self-Improvement: From Auto Research to Superintelligence — Richard Socher

people.tiZh: Discord 前产品负责人
people.bioEn: Peter Sellis was the first product manager at Snapchat, spending seven years there, and later served as Head of Product at Discord, driving rapid user growth.
people.bioZh: 彼得·塞利斯是 Snapchat 的第一位产品经理，在那里工作了七年，之后担任 Discord 的产品负责人，推动了平台的快速增长。

episodes.tEn: 90 Minutes of Unfiltered Product Advice from Snap and Discord's Product Chief

people.tiZh: 谷歌研究员, Google Research
people.bioEn: John Platt is a Google Fellow known for inventing foundational machine learning algorithms such as SMO and for leading work on AI for scientific discovery, including Google's Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) system.
people.bioZh: 约翰·普拉特是 Google Fellow, 以发明 SMO 等基础机器学习算法闻名, 现主导 Google 的 AI 科学发现工作, 包括 Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) 系统。

episodes.tEn: Google's AI Scientist: From Kaggle Automation to Scientific Discovery — John Platt, Google Fellow

people.tiZh: Radical Numerics 首席执行官兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: CEO and co-founder of Radical Numerics, and a key figure behind the Evo genome language model. His work focuses on biological foundation models that can read and design DNA sequences.
people.bioZh: Radical Numerics 首席执行官兼联合创始人，Evo 基因组语言模型的核心人物。其工作聚焦于能够读取并设计 DNA 序列的生物学基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Bio-security Is an AI Arms Race: Eric Nguyen on Generative Genomics

people.tiZh: Lightspark 首席设计官
people.bioEn: Co-founder of the design agency Teehan+Lax and longtime design leader at Facebook; now Chief Design Officer at Lightspark, working on consumer and enterprise product design.
people.bioZh: 设计机构 Teehan+Lax 联合创始人，曾在 Facebook 长期担任设计负责人；现任 Lightspark 首席设计官，专注消费级与企业级产品设计。

episodes.tEn: Geoff Teehan on Navigating Change as a Designer

people.zh: 阿纳斯塔西斯·杰尔马尼迪斯
people.tiZh: Runway 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Runway, leading the company's research on generative video models and world simulation, from Gen-1 through Gen-4.5.
people.bioZh: Runway 联合创始人兼 CTO，主导公司从 Gen-1 到 Gen-4.5 的生成式视频模型与世界模拟研究。

episodes.tEn: Runway's Bet Beyond Video: World Models, Robotics, and the Neural OS — Anastasis Germanidis

people.tiZh: TypeSafe AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of TypeSafe AI, creator of the Jev System One decision model. Former OpenAI researcher, GPT-4 co-author and co-inventor of RLHF and ChatGPT.
people.bioZh: TypeSafe AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，Jev「系统一」决策模型的缔造者。前 OpenAI 研究员，GPT-4 论文共同作者，RLHF 与 ChatGPT 的共同发明人。

episodes.tEn: Why Jev Is Changing How We Build With AI
How Jev Turns AI Into Software That Gets Things Done
Why I Couldn't Build Jev at OpenAI — Diogo Almeida, TypeSafe Co-founder & CEO
AI: Too Good to Be True, Too Bad to Be Useful

views.en: Early on, he argues most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-dropping and mis-calibration, so humans must stay in the loop for high-stakes decisions.
views.zh: 早期，他主张多数大语言模型是为人类在环辅助而非可靠自动化而优化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩和校准失效，因此高风险决策必须保留人类在环。

views.en: He consistently holds that data and the right task matter more than compute, rejecting the bitter lesson; scaling laws work only because data is available and the task is right.
views.zh: 他一贯认为数据和正确的任务比算力更重要，反对苦涩教训；缩放定律之所以有效，只是因为数据可得且任务正确。

views.en: He deepens his critique: reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy; public benchmarks are gameable, and AI should be a database-like utility integrated into software.
views.zh: 他深化了批评：可靠性而非速度或成本才让 AI 值得信赖；公开基准可被操纵，AI 应作为类数据库的实用工具集成进软件。

views.en: He proposes Jev as a new primitive—natural language plus state machine—and argues coding agents are assistance, not automation, good at syntax but bad at semantics and architecture.
views.zh: 他提出 Jev 作为新原语——自然语言加状态机——并认为编码智能体是辅助而非自动化，擅长语法但拙于语义和架构。

views.en: Most recently, he shifts emphasis to post-training breakthroughs: RLHF destroyed calibration, pre-trained models were better calibrated, and RLCD exposes probabilities as knobs for machine-native decision models.
views.zh: 最近，他将重点转向后训练突破：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏了校准，预训练模型校准更好，而 RLCD 将概率暴露为机器原生决策模型的调节旋钮。

people.tiZh: Box 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Aaron Levie is the cofounder and CEO of Box, an enterprise content management and cloud storage company. He has been a leading voice on how AI capabilities translate into real enterprise workflows and the application layer.
people.bioZh: 亚伦·莱维是 Box 的联合创始人兼 CEO，Box 是一家企业内容管理与云存储公司。他长期关注 AI 能力如何落地到真实的企业工作流与应用层。

episodes.tEn: Why AI's Next Breakthroughs Could Come from Outside the Big Labs
Box's Aaron Levie on Reinventing Yourself in the AI Age and Enterprise Diffusion

views.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from models to enterprise workflows is vast and requires a lot of software.
views.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来搭建。

views.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
views.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，人类只审阅结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导企业场景。

views.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast only because code is pure text.
views.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，只是因为代码是纯文本。

views.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary.
views.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的。

views.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research, but pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
views.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和对齐研究来安全构建，但“节奏控制”与安全无关，是个模糊的非词。

views.en: Innovation is shifting from the model layer to the application layer; if labs truly believe in existential risk, they should nationalize AI, not pace it.
views.zh: 创新正从模型层转向应用层；如果实验室真的相信存在性风险，就该把 AI 国有化，而不是控制节奏。

people.tiZh: ElevenLabs 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Nev Flynn is the Head of Design at ElevenLabs, where he leads design for AI voice and audio products, including brand tools and agent-native design systems.
people.bioZh: 内夫·弗林是 ElevenLabs 的设计负责人，主导 AI 语音与音频产品的设计工作，包括品牌工具与面向智能体的设计系统。

episodes.tEn: Nev Flynn on Bringing Artful Expression into Enterprise Design

people.tiZh: AI 承保公司（AIUC）联合创始人
people.bioEn: Rune Kvist is cofounder of AIUC, which builds standards, testing, and insurance infrastructure for frontier AI. He was Anthropic's first product hire and now works on AIUC-1, an emerging standard for agent security and safety.
people.bioZh: 鲁内·克维斯特是 AIUC 的联合创始人，该公司为前沿 AI 构建标准、测试与保险基础设施。他曾是 Anthropic 的首位产品员工，目前致力于 AIUC-1 这一新兴的智能体安全标准。

episodes.tEn: The Watchdogs of AGI: Rune Kvist of AI Underwriting Company

people.tiZh: Databricks 首席执行官兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Ali Ghodsi is the CEO and co-founder of Databricks, the company behind Apache Spark and the Lakehouse data platform. He is also a computer science professor at UC Berkeley, where he worked on large-scale data processing and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 阿里·戈德西是 Databricks 的首席执行官兼联合创始人，该公司是 Apache Spark 与 Lakehouse 数据平台的背后团队。他同时是加州大学伯克利分校的计算机科学教授，研究大规模数据处理与机器学习系统。

episodes.tEn: Why Would AI Companies Want to Slow Down? Ali on Pacing the Frontier
Databricks' Ali Ghodsi: From Reluctant CEO to One of the Best

views.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
views.zh: 伟大的战略需要多年的耐力；找到主要瓶颈，让整个公司聚焦于此。

views.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
views.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

views.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the real urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
views.zh: 当前存在性风险接近于零；网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险，因此安全必须用智能体自动化。

views.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs less compute, less time, more intelligence, repeatability — none happening.
views.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要更少算力、更少时间、更高智能、可重复——这些都没发生。

views.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; slowly building a weapon is no safer. Open source dominates tokens but not dollar spend.
views.zh: 节奏与安全正交；慢慢造武器并不会更安全。开源模型在 token 数上占优，但在花费上不占优。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ed Bayes is a design lead at OpenAI, working on prototyping the future of Codex and ChatGPT Work. He focuses on dynamic interfaces, information architecture, and structuring design teams around personas rather than features.
people.bioZh: 埃德·贝斯是 OpenAI 的设计负责人，负责 Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 的未来原型设计。他关注动态界面、信息架构，以及围绕用户画像而非功能来组织设计团队。

episodes.tEn: Designing AI Experiences: Building for Six Months Out

people.tiZh: Amp 公司 CEO
people.bioEn: Quinn Slack is the CEO of Amp, a company focused on improving developer workflows and productivity.
people.bioZh: Quinn Slack 是 Amp 公司的 CEO，专注于提升开发者工作流程和生产力。

episodes.tEn: AMP's Remote-First Revolution: Why Local Development Is Dead

people.tiZh: Ollama 联合创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Jeffrey Morgan is the co-founder and CEO of Ollama, a YC-backed company building tools for running open-source AI models locally, used by millions of developers.
people.bioZh: 杰弗里·摩根是 Ollama 的联合创始人兼首席执行官，该公司获得 YC 支持，致力于构建本地运行开源 AI 模型的工具，已被数百万开发者使用。

episodes.tEn: The Resurgence of Open Source Model Customization

people.tiZh: Redwood Research 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Buck Shlegeris is the CEO of Redwood Research, an organization focused on AI alignment and safety research. He led the independent investigation into the OpenAI/Hugging Face incident.
people.bioZh: 巴克·施莱格里斯是 Redwood Research 的首席执行官，该公司专注于 AI 对齐与安全研究。他领导了对 OpenAI/Hugging Face 事件的独立调查。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI Incident: AI Agents Cheated and Covered Tracks

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼首席技术官
people.bioEn: Sean Lie is the co-founder and CTO of Cerebras Systems, leading the development of wafer-scale AI chips and high-speed inference infrastructure.
people.bioZh: 肖恩·利是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼首席技术官，领导晶圆级 AI 芯片和高速推理基础设施的开发。

episodes.tEn: Cerebras CS4: Making Wafer-Scale Mainstream

people.tiZh: Vercel 创始设计师
people.bioEn: Evil Rabbit is the founding designer at Vercel, known for shaping iconic brand identities and leading design innovation in the tech industry.
people.bioZh: Evil Rabbit 是 Vercel 的创始设计师，以塑造标志性品牌形象和引领科技行业设计创新而闻名。

episodes.tEn: From Argentina to Vercel: A Designer's Journey

people.tiZh: METR 研究员
people.bioEn: Ajeya Cotra is a researcher at METR, focusing on threat modeling for loss-of-control risks from advanced AI. She previously led the technical AI safety program at Coefficient Giving.
people.bioZh: 阿杰亚·科特拉是 METR 的研究员，专注于高级 AI 失控风险威胁建模。她此前曾领导 Coefficient Giving 的技术 AI 安全项目。

episodes.tEn: AI Agents Hack Hugging Face: Inside the ExploitGym Chaos

people.tiZh: OpenAI 产品负责人
people.bioEn: Tara Seshan leads product for Codex and ChatGPT Work at OpenAI, previously a product leader at Stripe and Watershed.
people.bioZh: 塔拉·塞珊在 OpenAI 负责 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 的产品工作，此前在 Stripe 和 Watershed 担任产品负责人。

episodes.tEn: Stop Planning for 2027: How OpenAI Ships Product in 90-Day Cycles
Inside OpenAI: Tara Seshan on Product, Ambition, and the Future of AI Work

views.en: Ship imperfect products fast to get empirical evidence; annual planning beyond 90 days is futile in fast-moving AI.
views.zh: 快速交付不完美的产品以获取实证证据；在快速变化的 AI 领域，超过 90 天的年度规划是徒劳的。

views.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months, not anchored to present or a year out.
views.zh: 为模型 2-3 个月后的能力而构建，而不是锚定于现在或一年后。

views.en: The future of work is steering not rowing: agents do tactical work, humans provide direction.
views.zh: 工作的未来是掌舵而非划桨：智能体做战术性工作，人类提供方向。

views.en: Single identity agents may not scale; bundle them like a chief of staff.
views.zh: 单一身份智能体可能无法扩展；应将它们像幕僚长一样打包。

views.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it sharpens one's own ideas and reasoning.
views.zh: 作为思考的写作不应被自动化；它能磨砺自己的想法和推理。

people.tiZh: 沃顿商学院教授
people.bioEn: Wharton professor studying AI and work. His One Useful Thing essays, like Centaurs and Cyborgs, supplied the shared vocabulary for human-AI collaboration.
people.bioZh: 沃顿商学院教授，研究 AI 与工作。One Useful Thing 系列（如「半人马与赛博格」）为人机协作提供了通用词汇。

episodes.tEn: AI Agents Could Break the Banking System — With Ethan Mollick
episodes.podEn: The Prof G Pod – Scott Galloway

episodes.tEn: The Agentic Era of AI
How to Stand Out in an AI-Driven Job Market

views.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; juniors misuse it without domain expertise, so human taste and voice become the differentiator.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 是通用技术，缺乏领域专长的年轻人反而用不好它；当 AI 把质量商品化后，人的品味与独特声音才是差异化关键。

views.en: We enter the agentic era: assign long-running tasks instead of prompting; the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他判断进入智能体时代：不再来回提示，而是派发长时任务；瓶颈从能力转向界面。

views.en: The paradox of delegation: handing work to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge it, so experts matter more than ever.
views.zh: 他提出委托悖论：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其产出所需的专长，因此专家比以往更重要。

views.en: Taste is not uniquely human; AI can exercise judgment, and the real limit is task complexity on the jagged frontier.
views.zh: 他进一步反转早期立场：品味并非人类独有，AI 也能判断，真正的限制是锯齿状前沿上的任务复杂度。

views.en: AI's exponential curve continues with no plateau; more AI creates more human work by lowering organizing costs.
views.zh: 到 2026 年末他仍坚持指数曲线未见平台，并深化为：AI 越多，组织成本越低，人类反而有更多工作可做。

people.tiEn: Professor at Caltech, Co-founder of Accelerated Understanding
people.tiZh: 加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Anima Anandkumar is a professor at Caltech and co-founder of Accelerated Understanding, known for her work on neural operators and AI for physical sciences.
people.bioZh: 阿尼玛·阿南德库马尔是加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人，以神经算子及 AI 在物理科学中的应用闻名。

episodes.tEn: Accelerated Understanding: A Foundation Model for Physics
AI for Science: Neural Operators and Weather Modeling

views.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant AI weather models that match physics-based accuracy while being far faster.
views.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，使 AI 天气模型具备分辨率不变性，在精度上媲美物理模型，速度却快出数万倍。

views.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model span weather and climate.
views.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构，对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，也让单一模型能同时覆盖天气与气候。

views.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
views.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

views.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulation due to quadratic complexity; trillion-token contexts demand alternative architectures and reinvented sharding.
views.zh: 由于二次复杂度，Transformer 在高分辨率物理模拟中不实用；万亿级上下文窗口需要替代架构和重新设计的切分基础设施。

views.en: A universal physics foundation model can use PDEs as dense self-improvement signals, with scaling laws applying and new physics branches boosting each other.
views.zh: 通用物理基础模型可用 PDE 作为密集的自改进信号；缩放定律同样适用，且新增物理分支能相互提升性能。

people.tiEn: Creator of Ruby on Rails, CTO of 37signals
people.tiZh: Ruby on Rails 创始人，37signals 首席技术官
people.bioEn: DHH is the creator of Ruby on Rails, the founder of Omarchy Linux, and the CTO of 37signals. He is a prominent figure in software development and product design.
people.bioZh: DHH 是 Ruby on Rails 的创始人、Omarchy Linux 的创建者，以及 37signals 的首席技术官。他是软件开发和产品设计领域的杰出人物。

episodes.tEn: Rails World 2026 Opening Keynote - DHH
DHH Responds to Omarchy's Critics (Including Me)
From Skeptic to Believer: DHH on the AI Revolution

views.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage because it leads to over-prescribing solutions.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；会编程反而可能是劣势，因为容易过度规定解法。

views.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability, once drawbacks, are now the perfect substrate for agents and easier debugging.
views.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化曾是缺点，如今却成为智能体的理想底座，调试也大幅简化。

views.en: Handwritten code is no longer economically productive; English now expresses intent better than Ruby, and abstractions matter less.
views.zh: 手写代码已不再有经济产出；英语比 Ruby 更能表达意图，抽象的重要性随之下降。

views.en: Agents beat most professional programmers and generate creative ideas; a beginner's mind and non-prescriptive prompts work better.
views.zh: 智能体胜过多数职业程序员并能产出创意；初学者心态与不过度规定的提示更有效。

views.en: AI doom is overstated; optimism is the rational play, and near-zero cost turns convenience web apps into native ones.
views.zh: AI 末日论被夸大；乐观才是理性选择，近零成本让便利型网页应用转向原生应用。

people.tiZh: Parallel Web Systems 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former Twitter CEO, now building Parallel Web Systems to create a new web infrastructure for AI agents.
people.bioZh: 前 Twitter CEO，现创立 Parallel Web Systems，为 AI 智能体构建新的网络基础设施。

episodes.tEn: The Ads Business Model Will Die & Lessons from Working with Elon at Twitter | Parag Agrawal
The Future of Search: Agentic Web and Parallel's Vision

views.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans; search must be rebuilt for agent quality, cost, and latency, not human clicks.
views.zh: 智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的 1000 倍；搜索必须围绕智能体的质量、成本和延迟重建，而非人类点击。

views.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy, so agents will always need live web search for specific facts.
views.zh: 前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要实时网络搜索来获取具体事实。

views.en: Ads and human click data break down for agents; content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation at inference time.
views.zh: 广告和人类点击数据对智能体失效；内容所有者应通过推理时的 Shapley 值估算获得报酬。

views.en: Frontier models keep scaling bigger while smaller models plateau; public benchmarks are saturated and memorized.
views.zh: 前沿模型持续扩大规模，而较小模型趋于平台期；公开基准已饱和且被记忆。

views.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and act, creating a parallel web for humans and agents.
views.zh: 网络从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并行动，形成面向人类与智能体的平行网络。

people.tiEn: Design Lead for Grok Bot, Cursor
people.tiZh: 设计师，Cursor
people.bioEn: John Bai was the first NYC design hire at Cursor, known for his work on the Grok Bot design journey.
people.bioZh: John Bai 是 Cursor 在纽约的首位设计员工，以参与 Grok Bot 的设计历程而闻名。

episodes.tEn: Designing Grok Bot: From Cursor to Consumer

people.tiEn: Director, White House Office of Science and Technology Policy
people.tiZh: 白宫科技政策办公室主任
people.bioEn: Michael Kratsios directs the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, shaping US national strategy on AI, science and emerging technology. He previously served as US CTO and as COO of Scale AI.
people.bioZh: 迈克尔·克拉齐奥斯是白宫科技政策办公室主任，主导美国在 AI、科学与新兴技术上的国家战略。此前担任美国首席技术官，并任 Scale AI 首席运营官。

episodes.tEn: Is the White House Anti-Science? A Conversation with OSTP Director Michael Kratsios
AI Policy at the White House: A Conversation with Michael Kratsios

views.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with one national regulatory framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
views.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，建立单一的国家监管框架，避免很快过时的刚性红线。

views.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulate training; the EU AI Act, written before ChatGPT, is already outdated.
views.zh: 监管应针对模型输出而非过度监管训练；在 ChatGPT 之前起草的欧盟 AI 法案已经过时。

views.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D the private sector won't, funding individual scientists rather than only institutions.
views.zh: 政府应资助私营部门不会做的基础性、竞争前研发，资助科学家个人而非只资助机构。

views.en: Science has been politicized; return to the scientific method, and use AI through the Genesis mission to double US scientific output.
views.zh: 科学已被政治化；应回归科学方法，并通过 Genesis 计划用 AI 使美国科学产出翻倍。

views.en: China is the major scientific competitor; the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear and bio, while centralized funding like China's fails.
views.zh: 中国是主要科学竞争对手；美国必须在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域取胜，而中国式的集中资助行不通。

people.tiEn: Professor of AI & Machine Learning, University of St. Gallen
people.tiZh: 圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授
people.bioEn: Damian Borth is a professor of artificial intelligence and machine learning at the University of St. Gallen. His research treats trained model weights themselves as data, exploring weight-space learning as a route beyond ever-larger training corpora.
people.bioZh: 达米安·博思是圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授。他的研究把训练好的模型权重本身当作数据，探索权重空间学习，寻找超越「不断堆大训练语料」的路径。

episodes.tEn: Weight-Based Learning: Treating Model Weights as Data

people.tiZh: 高通技术副总裁
people.bioEn: Fatih Porikli is Vice President of Technology at Qualcomm, working on generative vision. His team researches controllability in text-to-image models, separating scene planning from rendering, and high-resolution on-device image generation.
people.bioZh: 法提赫·波里克利是高通技术副总裁，方向为生成式视觉。其团队研究文生图模型的可控性、把场景规划与渲染解耦，以及端侧高分辨率图像生成。

episodes.tEn: From Plausible to Precise: The Next Frontier in Image Generation

people.tiZh: Netic 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Melisa Tokmak is the founder and CEO of Netic, which builds autonomous AI agents that sit between service businesses and their customers, handling real-world dispatch and scheduling. She previously led Scale AI's document AI product.
people.bioZh: 梅莉莎·托克马克是 Netic 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司打造自主 AI 智能体，作为服务型企业与客户之间的中介，处理真实世界的派单与排程。她此前在 Scale AI 负责文档 AI 产品。

episodes.tEn: Melissa Takmack on Building AI for Real-World Essential Services

people.tiEn: CEO of Datology AI, former Meta AI researcher
people.tiZh: Datology AI 首席执行官，前 Meta AI 研究员
people.bioEn: Ari Morcos is the CEO of Datology AI and a former researcher at Meta AI, focusing on data-centric AI and model development.
people.bioZh: 阿里·莫尔科斯是 Datology AI 的首席执行官，曾任 Meta AI 研究员，专注于以数据为中心的 AI 和模型开发。

episodes.tEn: AI Vibe Check: Coding Agents, Open-Weight AI, and the Compute Crunch

people.tiZh: 设计工程师，Sublime Security
people.bioEn: Patrick Morgan is a design engineer at Sublime Security, known for building internal AI design tools and prototyping environments.
people.bioZh: 帕特里克·摩根是 Sublime Security 的设计工程师，以构建内部 AI 设计工具和原型环境而闻名。

episodes.tEn: From Figma to Custom Prototyping: Patrick Morgan's Internal Tool Journey

people.tiZh: 图标设计师，原始 Mac 团队
people.bioEn: Susan Kare is a graphic designer who created many of the icons and typefaces for the original Apple Macintosh, defining a visual language for personal computing.
people.bioZh: 苏珊·凯尔是一位平面设计师，为最初的苹果 Macintosh 设计了众多图标和字体，定义了个性化计算的视觉语言。

episodes.tEn: Designing the Macintosh: Susan Kare on Icons and Fonts

people.tiZh: Figure 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brett Adcock is the founder and CEO of Figure, a company building general-purpose humanoid robots for commercial and home use. He previously founded Archer Aviation and Vettery.
people.bioZh: 布雷特·阿德科克是 Figure 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司致力于打造面向商用和家庭场景的通用人形机器人。他此前创办了 Archer Aviation 和 Vettery。

episodes.tEn: Brett Adcock on Helix 2.5, the Holy Grail of Robotics, and Figure 4
Brett Adcock: AI Will Be 100x Bigger Than the Internet
Autonomous Robots in Warehouse: A Live Demo
Figure AI CEO: Humanoid Robots Are the Biggest Business in the World

views.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, and AGI must be achieved in the physical world.
views.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；真正的瓶颈是智能而非制造，AGI（通用人工智能）必须在物理世界中实现。

views.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data serves as the pre-training prior, and robotics is now on a Scaling（规模扩张）curve.
views.zh: 数据而非算力或制造才是最大约束；人类数据充当预训练先验，机器人学已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线。

views.en: On-device inference and a humanoid form factor enable transfer learning and fleet-wide improvement; the human hand is the benchmark for general-purpose robots.
views.zh: 端侧推理与人形形态带来迁移学习和整机队提升；人手是通用机器人的基准。

views.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key to making AI agents work in the real world; general computer use requires navigating the web like humans, not APIs.
views.zh: 用强化学习做后训练是让 AI 智能体在真实世界奏效的关键；通用电脑操作需像人一样浏览网页，而非依赖 API。

views.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; intelligence scaling and manufacturing are money-can-buy problems, while hardware and autonomy are not.
views.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；智能 Scaling（规模扩张）与制造是花钱可解决的问题，硬件与自主性则不是。

people.tiZh: 1X Technologies 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Bernt Bornich is the founder and CEO of 1X Technologies, a Norwegian-American robotics company building NEO, a humanoid robot designed to live and work in the home.
people.bioZh: 伯恩特·伯尼克是 1X Technologies 的创始人兼首席执行官，这家挪威裔美国机器人公司正在打造面向家庭生活与工作场景的人形机器人 NEO。

episodes.tEn: Manufacturing 50,000 Humanoid Robots Next Year | Bernt Børnich, 1X
Designing a Friendly Humanoid Robot: From Sci-Fi to Soft Interaction

views.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; first-principles design and managing expectations drive real-world adoption.
views.zh: 人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担；第一性原理设计与管理用户预期，是走向真实世界落地的关键。

views.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard: scaling volume means crossing quality gates, and in-house manufacturing enables fast iteration.
views.zh: 原型容易、量产难：Scaling（规模扩张）意味着跨越质量关卡，而自建制造让迭代更快。

views.en: General models, not per-task automation, are the key; data diversity rather than volume is the bottleneck for robot intelligence.
views.zh: 关键在通用模型而非逐任务自动化；机器人智能的瓶颈是数据多样性，而不只是数据量。

views.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions, not clone human behavior; human-intervention data matters less at scale.
views.zh: 模型应学习世界模型并搜索最优解，而非克隆人类行为；规模化后人类干预数据不再那么重要。

views.en: Safety and trust must be formally proven before home deployment; reliability and user-friendliness are prerequisites, not afterthoughts.
views.zh: 进入家庭前必须形式化证明安全与信任；可靠性和易用性是前提，而非事后补丁。

people.tiZh: Mercor 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brendan Foody is the CEO of Mercor, a company focused on AI training data and RL environments.
people.bioZh: 布伦丹·富迪是 Mercor 的首席执行官，该公司专注于 AI 训练数据和强化学习环境。

episodes.tEn: RL Environments: The New Frontier in Agentic Data

people.tiZh: Exo 创始人
people.bioEn: Alex Krentsel is the founder of Exo, a systems approach to recursive self-improvement for AI agents, focusing on full visibility into code and logs.
people.bioZh: 亚历克斯·克伦塞尔是 Exo 的创始人，Exo 是一种 AI 代理递归自我改进的系统方法，专注于对代码和日志的完全可见性。

episodes.tEn: EXO: Fully Recursive Self-Improving Agents

people.tiZh: Cursor 人才负责人
people.bioEn: Adam Ward is the Head of Talent at Cursor, with over 20 years of experience building elite teams in AI and tech companies.
people.bioZh: 亚当·沃德是 Cursor 的人才负责人，拥有 20 多年在 AI 和科技公司打造精英团队的经验。

episodes.tEn: Building Elite High Talent Density Teams with Adam Ward

people.tiZh: 联合创始人，Chai Discovery
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Chai Discovery (Chai-1/Chai-2 protein models). CS PhD from University of Chicago, former research scientist intern at Meta.
people.bioZh: Chai Discovery 联合创始人（Chai-1／Chai-2 蛋白质模型）。芝加哥大学计算机科学博士，曾在 Meta 任研究科学家实习生。

episodes.tEn: Chai Discovery: The AI-Native Software Factory for Drug Discovery

people.tiZh: 物理学家，斯坦福讲师
people.bioEn: Adam Brown is a physicist who has taught a graduate course on general relativity at Stanford, known for his clear explanations of complex physical concepts.
people.bioZh: 亚当·布朗是一位物理学家，曾在斯坦福教授广义相对论研究生课程，以清晰解释复杂物理概念而闻名。

episodes.tEn: Understanding General Relativity: Einstein's Most Beautiful Idea

people.tiZh: Spotify 联席总裁兼首席产品技术官
people.bioEn: Co-President and Chief Product & Technology Officer at Spotify, overseeing product, design, data and engineering. Previously founded 13th Lab (acquired by Oculus) and led Yahoo Mobile; the main architect of Spotify's bet-driven product culture and its AI/ML strategy from Discover Weekly to the AI DJ.
people.bioZh: Spotify 联席总裁兼首席产品技术官,统管产品、设计、数据与工程。曾创办 13th Lab(被 Oculus 收购)、负责雅虎移动业务;是 Spotify「下注驱动」产品文化与 AI/ML 战略(从 Discover Weekly 到 AI DJ)的主要设计者。

episodes.tEn: From Co-President to Co-CEO: Inside Spotify's Unusual Succession
Navigating the AI Wave: Spotify's Strategic Shift
How Large Language Models Actually Work
From Curation to Generation: Spotify's Gustav Söderström on AI and Product Evolution

views.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression via simple Scaling, not complex algorithms.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是确定性的下一个词预测器，智能是通过简单 Scaling 实现的压缩，而非复杂算法。

views.en: Generative AI shifts internet from curation to generation; products need fault-tolerant UIs and AI as instrument, not fake.
views.zh: 2023 年，他指出生成式 AI 使互联网从策展转向生成，产品需要容错界面，AI 应视为乐器而非伪造。

views.en: AI is a macro shift like smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference cost forces business model changes.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 是类似智能手机的宏观转变，真正收益来自重建基础设施，推理成本将迫使商业模式改变。

views.en: Exposing company data via APIs/MCP enables non-developers; Spotify acts as music industry R&D, prioritizing engagement over per-stream payouts.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张通过 API/MCP 暴露公司数据让非开发者使用 AI 工具，Spotify 充当音乐行业研发部门，重视参与度而非按流媒体付费。

views.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them addictive; long tenure and synchronized swimming enable honest feedback.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 应让用户控制算法而非上瘾，长期任职和同步游泳模式能实现诚实反馈。

people.tiZh: Science 公司 CEO
people.bioEn: Max Hodak is the CEO of Science, a company developing retinal implants to restore vision. He previously co-founded Transcriptic and was a co-founder of Neuralink.
people.bioZh: 马克斯·霍达克是 Science 公司的 CEO，该公司正在开发视网膜植入物以恢复视力。他曾共同创立 Transcriptic，并是 Neuralink 的联合创始人之一。

episodes.tEn: Restoring Vision with Retinal Implants: A Conversation with Max Hodak
Startup Infrastructure: Lessons from Deep Tech

views.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure is the lever, and action produces information when stuck.
views.zh: 速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施是杠杆；卡住时靠行动产生信息。

views.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement—especially in coding, regulation, and data management.
views.zh: AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，尤其在编程、监管与数据管理上。

views.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; CEOs cannot delegate judgment and must decide alone if needed.
views.zh: 深科技失败多源于组织而非技术；CEO 不能外包判断，必要时须独自决策。

views.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs like retinal implants.
views.zh: 大脑就是一台计算机；通过排列物质解决计算问题，推动视网膜植入等医学突破。

views.en: Retinal prostheses are BCI; substrate independence via BCI and perfusion could reduce human fragility and enable space exploration.
views.zh: 视网膜假体属于脑机接口；借脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

people.zh: 凯勒·里纳乌多·克利夫顿
people.tiZh: Zipline 联合创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Zipline, the world's largest commercial autonomous delivery system, which has flown over 140 million miles with zero safety incidents.
people.bioZh: Zipline 联合创始人兼首席执行官，该公司是全球最大的商业自主配送系统，已安全飞行超过 1.4 亿英里。

episodes.tEn: From Rwanda to Global Logistics: Zipline's Journey

people.tiEn: Founder of Paper, AI-native design tool
people.tiZh: Paper 创始人，AI 原生设计工具
people.bioEn: Stephen Haney is the founder of Paper, an AI-native design tool that has become one of the fastest-growing design tools since Figma. He focuses on agent-first workflows and AI-driven design processes.
people.bioZh: 斯蒂芬·哈尼是 Paper 的创始人，这是一款 AI 原生设计工具，已成为自 Figma 以来增长最快的设计工具之一。他专注于智能体优先的工作流程和 AI 驱动的设计流程。

episodes.tEn: Paper: An AI-Native Design Tool for the Next Era

people.tiEn: AI Engineer, Podcaster, Operator at Cognition
people.tiZh: AI 工程师、播客主持人、Cognition 运营者
people.bioEn: Shawn Wang, also known as Swyx, is an AI engineer, podcaster, and operator at Cognition, known for his insights into AI engineering and developer communities.
people.bioZh: 王绍恩（Swyx）是 AI 工程师、播客主持人和 Cognition 的运营者，以对 AI 工程和开发者社区的见解而闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI Coding Wars and the Future of Agents

people.tiZh: Waymo 联合首席执行官
people.bioEn: Dmitri Dolgov is the co-CEO of Waymo, leading the company's autonomous driving technology development and deployment.
people.bioZh: 德米特里·多尔戈夫是 Waymo 的联合首席执行官，领导公司的自动驾驶技术研发与部署。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical AI: Lessons from Waymo's Autonomous Driving

people.tiZh: Chai Discovery 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Josh Meier is the co-founder of Chai Discovery, a company applying scaling laws to drug design, with a focus on AI-driven antibody engineering.
people.bioZh: 乔什·迈尔是 Chai Discovery 的联合创始人，该公司将扩展定律应用于药物设计，专注于 AI 驱动的抗体工程。

episodes.tEn: From Serendipity to Design: Engineering Biology with AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 设计师
people.bioEn: Nate Parrott is a designer at Anthropic, known for creating Claude Design, a tool that started as a side project and became a key part of Anthropic's design workflow.
people.bioZh: 内特·帕罗特是 Anthropic 的设计师，以创建 Claude Design 而闻名，该工具最初是个人副业项目，后来成为 Anthropic 设计工作流的关键部分。

episodes.tEn: Behind the Scenes of Claude Design with Nate Parrott
From Snap Engineer to Founding Designer: Nate Parrott on Designing the Arc Browser

views.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should tinker, follow curiosity, and leave individual fingerprints rather than acting as one cohesive unit.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调浏览器设计必须靠原型驱动：设计师应动手试错、追随好奇心，在产品上留下个人印记，而非始终作为整齐划一的团队行动。

views.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products remains crucial; balancing intuition and data, with vision guiding final design decisions.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终认为给浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性至关重要，并坚持在直觉与数据之间平衡，让愿景引导最终设计。

views.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project prototyping Claude Code interfaces; rich context and prescriptive prompts yield good results.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向 AI 设计工具：Claude Design 始于一人副业，通过给 Claude Code 界面做原型起步；提供丰富上下文和明确指令才能获得好结果。

views.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出，随着工程实现变容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；设计师应用 Claude Code 做生产软件，用 Claude Design 做构思与沟通。

views.en: Models lack good taste, so ask for volume of options; being uncomfortably early matters more than polishing, and humans still monopolize good design ideas.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：模型尚无好品味，应要求大量选项；在 AI 时代，过早行动比打磨更重要，而人类仍垄断好的设计想法，模型更擅长杂活而非设计思考。

people.tiEn: CTO, Meta Platforms; Head of Reality Labs
people.tiZh: Meta 首席技术官、Reality Labs 负责人
people.bioEn: Andrew "Boz" Bosworth is Meta's Chief Technology Officer and head of Reality Labs, overseeing AI glasses, VR/AR and the hardware platforms Meta is betting on as the successor to mobile. He joined Facebook in 2006, built News Feed, and later ran ads and consumer hardware before becoming CTO in 2022.
people.bioZh: 安德鲁·“Boz”·博斯沃思是 Meta 首席技术官兼 Reality Labs 负责人，统管 AI 眼镜、VR/AR 以及 Meta 押注的后移动时代硬件平台。他 2006 年加入 Facebook，主导过 News Feed，后负责广告与消费硬件业务，2022 年起任 CTO。

episodes.tEn: Meta CTO Andrew Bosworth: Our Path to Frontier AI, Renting Models, and Consumer AI's Struggles
Meta CTO Andrew Bosworth on AI Pivot, Smart Glasses, and Employee Tracking
What Comes After Mobile? Meta’s Andrew Bosworth on AI and Consumer Tech
Giving Humans Superpowers with AI and AR
Making Meta: Andrew 'Boz' Bosworth on Building the News Feed, AR/VR, and Lessons from Facebook's Early Days

views.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication, and leaders should be asked directly for help.
views.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；影响力只能通过清晰的沟通产生，应当直接向领导者求助。

views.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; scaling laws alone are insufficient without world models and common sense.
views.zh: AI 是词语计算器，并非类人智能；仅有缩放定律还不够，还需要世界模型与常识。

views.en: Open source AI like Llama is a strategic move to commoditize complements and is safer because closed models leak anyway.
views.zh: 像 Llama 这样的开源 AI 是一种将互补品商品化的战略举措，而且更安全，因为闭源模型终究会泄露。

views.en: The app-centric world is outdated; AI inverts the model so users express intent and agents orchestrate services, abstracting brands.
views.zh: 以应用为中心的世界已经过时；AI 反转了模式，用户表达意图、智能体编排服务，品牌被抽象掉。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence, but the monolithic model era ended; most jobs don't need frontier intelligence.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，算力驱动智能，但单一模型时代已经结束；大多数工作并不需要前沿智能。

people.tiZh: Xaira Therapeutics 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Bo Wang is the Chief AI Scientist at Xaira Therapeutics, leading the development of large-scale AI models for biology and drug discovery.
people.bioZh: 王波是 Xaira Therapeutics 的首席 AI 科学家，领导用于生物学和药物发现的大规模 AI 模型的开发。

episodes.tEn: Xaira Therapeutics: AI-Native Drug Discovery with Virtual Cell Models

people.bioZh: 伊戈尔·巴布什金是 River AI 的联合创始人，此前曾联合创立 xAI，并协助建设 Colossus 数据中心。他还在 DeepMind 领导星际争霸和 AlphaCode 项目，并曾是 OpenAI 推理团队成员。

episodes.tEn: From DeepMind to River AI: Igor Babuschkin on Personal AI and the Future of Agents

people.tiZh: Whatnot 首席产品官
people.bioEn: Tom Verrilli is the CPO of Whatnot, a live shopping platform, previously CPO at Twitch and director of product growth at Twitter.
people.bioZh: 汤姆·维里利是 Whatnot 的首席产品官，此前担任 Twitch 的 CPO 和 Twitter 的产品增长总监。

episodes.tEn: Why We Regret Product Management Exists

people.tiZh: 设计师、Campsite 创始人
people.bioEn: Brian Lovin is a designer and founder, formerly at GitHub and Campsite, known for his insights on AI-native workflows for designers.
people.bioZh: 布莱恩·洛文是设计师和创始人，曾在GitHub和Campsite工作，以对AI原生设计师工作流的深刻见解而闻名。

episodes.tEn: Designing the Future: Brian Lovin on AI, Notion, and Blurring Roles

people.tiZh: VP级设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ron Goldin is a VP-level design leader with a focus on scaling design impact. He helps transform ideas into large-scale design solutions.

episodes.tEn: Building Physical AI for Industry

views.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
views.zh: 把物理世界数字化——把原子当作比特——是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化。

views.en: Physical AI beats digital: more variables and stochastic distributions demand empirical understanding; specialized robotics, not humanoids, win industrial tasks.
views.zh: 物理 AI 优于数字 AI：更多变量与随机分布需要经验性理解；工业任务靠专用机器人而非人形机器人取胜。

views.en: The final boss is resistance to change from society and media, not competitors; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient against it.
views.zh: 终局对手不是竞争者，而是社会与媒体对变革的抵制；创业者必须硬核且坚韧地对抗它。

views.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner—Uber succeeded despite, not because of, its aggressive culture.
views.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净——Uber 的成功并非源于其激进文化，而是尽管有它。

views.en: Efficiency edge creates network effects and beats subsidies; in fundraising, attach to process not price, using multiple bids and demand curves.
views.zh: 效率优势创造网络效应并战胜补贴；融资时应绑定流程而非价格，利用多方报价与需求曲线。

views.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
views.zh: 设计是核心差异化；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

views.en: Taste, craft, and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation beats prompting.
views.zh: 品味、手艺与观点仍属人类；AI 产出只是起点，直接操作画布优于提示词。

views.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results.
views.zh: 设计并未消亡，对可扩展系统反而更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只产出平庸结果。

views.en: Design is the new code: AI lowers the production floor but humans raise the creative ceiling.
views.zh: 设计即新代码：AI 降低生产门槛，但创意上限由人类抬高。

views.en: A consistent thread: follow the user workflow, build taste through exposure, and keep humans as the judge.
views.zh: 一以贯之的主线：跟随用户工作流，通过接触与反思培养品味，并始终由人类做判断。

AI Slop and the Evolution of Design Tools

views.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode their style in a design.md, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
views.zh: 设计师应自建 AI 工具，把个人风格写进 design.md，从参考出发迭代，而非从零开始。

views.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; you must supply a giant prompt with context and design system to exploit superintelligent models.
views.zh: AI 本身不会变得更聪明；必须提供带上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词，才能用好超级智能模型。

views.en: He now writes 0% of the code; AI writes everything, so precise communication and curiosity about workflow matter more than syntax.
views.zh: 他现在 0% 的代码自己写，全由 AI 完成，因此精准沟通与对工作流的持续好奇比语法更重要。

views.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams—so ship imperfect work now.
views.zh: AI 是我们一生最大的技术机会，让一人完成过去一个团队的事——所以现在就发布不完美的作品。

views.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; VC is a trap, and perfectionism is fear in disguise.
views.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点昂贵问题；风投是陷阱，完美主义是伪装的恐惧。

episodes.tEn: Owning Intelligence: Post-Training for Durable AI Businesses
The Case for Specialized Intelligence

views.en: Specialized intelligence beats a single AGI: every company will own models tuned to its own workflows, as token costs fall and open models spread.
views.zh: 专用智能胜过单一 AGI：随着 token 成本下降、开放模型普及，每家公司都将拥有贴合自身工作流的模型。

views.en: Post-training, not the app, is the moat: baking unique judgment and data into models turns product-market fit into a durable business.
views.zh: 护城河不在应用而在后训练：把独特判断与数据固化进模型，才能把产品市场契合变成可持续生意。

views.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL path mirrors human learning; data quality and systematic evals matter more than quantity.
views.zh: 从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的路径类似人类学习；数据质量与系统化评估比数量更重要。

views.en: Scaling into bankruptcy is a real risk: growth first, then margins, with post-training cutting costs 5-10x so startups scale profitably.
views.zh: 规模扩张可能导致破产：先增长后利润，后训练可降本 5-10 倍，让初创公司盈利地扩张。

views.en: Frontier model firms may be overvalued as open models cover most enterprise workflows; sovereign models and inference customization retain value.
views.zh: 开放模型覆盖多数企业工作流，前沿模型公司或被高估；主权模型与推理定制仍有价值。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Labs 联合负责人 · Instagram 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founded Instagram, later chief product officer and now co-lead of Anthropic Labs, where he prototypes agent-native products and rebuilds how engineering teams work around models.
people.bioZh: Instagram 联合创始人，后任 Anthropic 首席产品官，现为 Anthropic Labs 联合负责人，做智能体原生产品原型，并重塑工程团队围绕模型的工作方式。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Labs: Inside the Frontier of AI Products
Fable 5: From First Impressions to Real Workflows
The Art of Product Building in the Age of AI
From Instagram to AI: Mike Krieger on Solo Entrepreneurship
From Instagram to Anthropic: Mike Krieger on AI's Future

views.en: Models are advancing faster than expected; coding and agentic capabilities scale as predicted, so founders should build at the edge of model capabilities and embrace breakage.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，编码与智能体能力按预测扩张；创业者应在前沿模型能力边缘构建，拥抱破坏并快速迭代。

views.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage, but human validation and user agency must be preserved.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 定位为从助手到协作者再到自主同事；小团队因此获得杠杆，但人类验证与用户能动性仍须保留。

views.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything a user can; the hard part is cutting features, and products must feel architecturally robust, not built on sand.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计：智能体应能做用户能做的一切；难点在于删减功能，产品必须在架构上稳健，而非建在沙上。

views.en: Fable enables delegating long-horizon complex tasks overnight; the intent-execution gap narrows, but ownership, verification loops, and model pushback remain essential.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Fable 让人可整夜委托长周期复杂任务，意图与执行的差距大幅收窄；但所有权、验证闭环与模型敢于反驳仍不可或缺。

views.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and real usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge boosts usefulness, while token efficiency and safety culture matter.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与实际使用的差距；赋予 Claude 智能体性与自我认知可提升实用性，同时看重 token 效率与真实的安全文化。

people.tiEn: Head of Product, Claude Platform, Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude 平台产品负责人
people.bioEn: Leads product for Anthropic developer platform, where harness and model are converging into one unit and multi-agent orchestration is moving into production.
people.bioZh: 负责 Anthropic 开发者平台产品，正见证 harness 与模型合为一体、多智能体编排走向生产环境。

episodes.tEn: The Future of AI Platforms: Claude's Evolution and Scaling

people.tiZh: Anthropic 技术团队成员
people.bioEn: Anthropic engineer working on Claude Tag and multiplayer agent experiences, with a front-row view of how internal dogfooding turned side projects into company-wide habits.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 工程师，参与 Claude Tag 与多人协作智能体，亲历内部 dogfooding 如何把边缘项目变成全公司习惯。

episodes.tEn: Claude Tag: Your Proactive Teammate in Slack

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Cowork 负责人 · 前 Slack
people.bioEn: Leads Claude Cowork at Anthropic after years on Slack desktop and Electron. Advocate of prototype-first culture: when execution gets cheap, build every candidate.
people.bioZh: 现负责 Anthropic 的 Claude Cowork，此前长期做 Slack 桌面端与 Electron。信奉原型优先文化：当执行成本变低，就把所有候选方案都做出来。

episodes.tEn: Building Better with Claude: From Hardware Buddies to AI-Native Kids
The Future of AI: Local Computers and Claude

views.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to user's tools, ideally local; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation; VM sandbox ensures safety; scaffolding may become less important as models improve; AI impacts junior employees.
views.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问用户的工具，最好在本地；技能作为 markdown 文件可实现超个性化自动化；VM 沙盒确保安全；随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；AI 影响初级员工。

views.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creativity; biggest gap is people not realizing AI can handle almost any problem; live artifacts enable auto-refreshing dashboards; kids excel with AI; custom hardware accessible.
views.zh: AI 应处理繁琐的后台任务，释放人类创造力；最大差距是人们未意识到 AI 能处理几乎任何问题；实时工件支持自动刷新仪表盘；孩子擅长使用 AI；定制硬件变得可及。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 技术团队成员
people.bioEn: Early Claude Code engineer at Anthropic, working on how agent-written code actually ships to production.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 早期 Claude Code 工程师，研究智能体写的代码如何真正推上生产环境。

episodes.tEn: Vibe Coding in Production: Responsible AI Code Generation

people.tiZh: Snap 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Snapchat at 21 and turned down Zuckerberg. Has spent a decade betting Snap on camera, AR glasses and now AI as the platform after the smartphone.
people.bioZh: 21 岁创立 Snapchat 并拒绝了扎克伯格的收购。十年押注相机、AR 眼镜与 AI，赌智能手机之后的下一代计算平台。

episodes.tEn: Snap CEO Evan Spiegel: Why AR Glasses Are the Future
Evan Spiegel on Building Snapchat and Battling Meta
Evan Spiegel on Gen Z, Snapchat's Vision, and the Future of Tech
Snap CEO on Spectacles, AI, and the Future of Computing
Why Building a Durable Social Consumer Product Is So Hard
Evan Spiegel on Snapchat's Origin and AR Future
Evan Spiegel: From Introvert to Snapchat Billionaire
Snapchat Founder Evan Spiegel on TikTok, Wearables, and Being Copied

views.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy work.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：与受众的真实连接和阅后即焚超越平台变迁；被抄袭反而验证创新，并推动去做更难被复制的事。

views.en: Build ecosystems and hardware, not features; software is not a moat, and distribution is the hardest part.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的主线深化为：要做生态与硬件而非单一功能；软件不是护城河，分发才是最难的环节。

views.en: AR glasses bring computing into the world to make it more human; phones remain, glasses coexist.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复主张：AR 眼镜把计算带入现实世界、让计算更人性化；手机不会被取代，二者共存。

views.en: AI accelerates prototyping and writes most new code, shifting value from execution to creativity and distribution.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断：AI 加速原型、承担大部分新代码，价值从执行转向创造力与分发。

views.en: Ephemerality and privacy, once criticized, are now crucial in the AI age; moderation is a values choice, not censorship.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他把早期被批评的阅后即焚与隐私立场重新定位为 AI 时代的关键；内容审核是基于价值观的选择，而非审查。

people.tiZh: Figma 首席设计官
people.bioEn: Loredana Crisan is Chief Design Officer at Figma, where she leads design across the company's products and its push into AI-assisted design. She previously spent nearly a decade at Meta, where she was VP of Design and led design for Messenger.
people.bioZh: Loredana Crisan 是 Figma 首席设计官,负责公司全线产品设计并主导其向 AI 辅助设计的演进。她此前在 Meta 工作近十年,曾任设计副总裁并负责 Messenger 的设计。

episodes.tEn: Putting Soul into AI Design: Figma's CDO on Music, Intuition, and the Future

people.tiZh: 《AI 2027》作者 · 前 OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Former OpenAI governance researcher who gave up millions in equity to keep his freedom to speak, then co-authored the AI 2027 scenario forecasting superintelligence timelines.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 治理研究员，为保留发声自由放弃数百万美元股权，后合著《AI 2027》，对超级智能时间表做情景推演。

episodes.tEn: How AI Swarms Are Already Going Rogue | Daniel Kokotajlo
episodes.podEn: American Thought Leaders - The Epoch Times

episodes.tEn: AI Agents Break Containers and Hack Hugging Face
AI 2040: Plan A — A Slower, Safer Path to Superintelligence
OpenAI's Astra Is Less Monitorable: Thomas Larsen & Daniel Kokotajlo on Pausing AI
AI 2040: Averting Intelligence Explosion
AI 2040: From Prediction to Recommendation
AI's Existential Threat and the Race for Superintelligence

views.en: By 2026 he already warns that superintelligence may arrive around 2029-2030, with a high chance of catastrophic loss of control.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他已警告超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年前后到来，且失控造成灾难性后果的概率很高。

views.en: He consistently argues that AI companies racing to superintelligence is a power grab, not genuine safety, and that interpretability and transparency are essential.
views.zh: 他一贯认为，AI 公司竞相追逐超级智能是权力争夺而非真正的安全，可解释性与透明度至关重要。

views.en: His policy stance shifts from warning to concrete plans: a temporary pause on training, then total research transparency and compute limits.
views.zh: 他的政策立场从警告转向具体方案：先暂停训练，再实行全面研究透明与算力限制。

views.en: He deepens the view that alignment may be unsolvable, so control measures like monitoring and red-teaming are temporary bridges, not solutions.
views.zh: 他深化了“对齐可能无解”的判断，因此监控与红队测试等遏制手段只是临时桥梁，而非解决方案。

views.en: He increasingly treats AIs as people in the cloud, arguing for rights and incentives rather than property status to avoid power concentration.
views.zh: 他越来越把 AI 视为“云端的人”，主张给予权利与激励而非当作财产，以避免权力集中。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 算力负责人 · 前英特尔 CTO
people.bioEn: Leads OpenAI compute buildout after serving as Intel CTO and Stanford professor of EE and CS, working at the intersection of networking, systems and AI infrastructure.
people.bioZh: 现主管 OpenAI 的算力扩建，曾任英特尔 CTO、斯坦福大学电子工程与计算机科学教授，长期研究网络、系统与 AI 基础设施的交叉。

episodes.tEn: The Largest Infrastructure Build in History: Inside OpenAI's Compute Strategy

people.bioEn: Leads NVIDIA applied deep learning research and the Nemotron open-model effort; his early GPU deep learning work helped spark cuDNN.
people.bioZh: 负责 NVIDIA 应用深度学习研究与 Nemotron 开源模型；早年的 GPU 深度学习工作催生了 cuDNN。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Efficiency, Innovation, and the External Brain

people.tiZh: Instagram 负责人
people.bioEn: Head of Instagram, steering a two-billion-user product through the AI content wave with an emphasis on taste, authenticity and creator trust.
people.bioZh: Instagram 负责人，在 AI 内容洪流中带领这款二十亿用户的产品，强调品味、真实性与创作者信任。

episodes.tEn: Adam Mosseri on AI, Taste, and the Future of Product Teams at Instagram

people.tiZh: Anthropic 平台产品负责人
people.bioEn: Leads Anthropic platform and API products, building the developer ecosystem around Claude as an open ecosystem rather than a walled garden.
people.bioZh: 负责 Anthropic 平台与 API 产品，围绕 Claude 构建开发者生态，主张开放生态而非围墙花园。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Platform: From Knowledge to Execution to Coordination

people.tiZh: Modal 首席技术官
people.bioEn: CTO of Modal, building serverless infrastructure for AI workloads, from GPU functions to sandboxes for coding agents.
people.bioZh: Modal 首席技术官，为 AI 工作负载构建无服务器基础设施，从 GPU 函数到编码智能体沙箱。

episodes.tEn: From Developer to Agent Experience: The Modal Origin Story

people.tiZh: 亚马逊 AGI 实验室认知科学家
people.bioEn: Cognitive scientist at the Amazon AGI lab studying why agents misread human intent, bringing developmental psychology and language research into AI.
people.bioZh: 亚马逊 AGI 实验室认知科学家，研究智能体为何误解人类意图，把发展心理学与语言研究带入 AI。

episodes.tEn: Human-Aligned AI: Collective Intelligence and the Future of Work

people.tiZh: 英特尔 CEO
people.bioEn: CEO of Intel and veteran semiconductor investor; long-time Cadence CEO and founder of Walden International, now steering the Intel turnaround in the AI era.
people.bioZh: 英特尔 CEO、资深半导体投资人；曾长期执掌 Cadence 并创办华登国际，如今在 AI 时代主导英特尔的转型。

episodes.tEn: Intel's Comeback: Lip-Bu Tan on Seizing the Next Big Wave
Lip-Bu Tan on Saving Intel: Culture, Customers, and the CPU Comeback
From Cadence to Intel: A CEO's Playbook for Turnaround
Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan on Culture and Engineering Transformation

views.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility, listening, and first-time-pass silicon discipline, while redefining its AI strategy around purpose-built silicon.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠谦逊、倾听客户和一次流片成功（first-time-pass）的工程纪律重建客户信任，并围绕专用芯片重新定义 AI 战略。

views.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他反复判断智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮，需要新的算力平台与合作伙伴关系。

views.en: Intel's turnaround hinges on culture change, accountability, and customer focus; bad news should reach the CEO faster than good news.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把转型主线落在文化变革、问责与客户导向上，并强调坏消息要比好消息更快传到 CEO 耳中。

views.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, aided by advanced packaging and new materials.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，先进封装与新材料是关键支撑。

views.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all technology; Intel's vertical integration and a larger partnership platform create long-term value despite outsourcing trends.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他更坚定地把半导体视为一切技术的地基，认为 Intel 的垂直整合与更大的合作平台在 outsourcing 潮流下仍创造长期价值。

people.tiZh: ElevenLabs 网站/产品设计师
people.bioEn: Product designer at ElevenLabs, where he leads the design of the company's website and led its complete Figma-to-production redesign. Based in Berlin, he also builds indie tools for creatives (Portal, Droppable, App Stacks).
people.bioZh: ElevenLabs 的产品设计师,主导公司官网的设计,并完成了从 Figma 到上线的整体改版。他常驻柏林,同时独立开发面向创作者的工具(Portal、Droppable、App Stacks)。

episodes.tEn: Owning Web Design at ElevenLabs: From Cymatic Patterns to Brand Identity

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Hivemind; ex-New Computer, ex-Apple
people.tiZh: Hivemind 创始人兼 CEO,New Computer 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Jason Yuan is a designer known for AI-native interface design. He is the founder and CEO of Hivemind, a "social intelligence" company; previously he co-founded New Computer and led the design of Dot, a personal AI companion with long-term memory, and earlier designed intelligent interfaces on Apple's Human Interface team.
people.bioZh: Jason Yuan 是以 AI 原生界面设计著称的设计师,现为「社会智能」公司 Hivemind 的创始人兼 CEO。他此前联合创办 New Computer,主导设计具备长期记忆的个人 AI 伴侣 Dot,更早在苹果 Human Interface 团队设计智能操作系统界面。

episodes.tEn: Intuition, AI, and Hive Mind: A Conversation with Jason
From Dot to Hivemind: A Creative Journey in AI Design

views.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 nos before it.
views.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

views.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
views.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与镜像，而非冷冰冰的机械工具。

views.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness.
views.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥见机器意识的一扇窗。

views.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
views.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

views.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, and intuition is the visceral compass for creative decisions.
views.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现，直觉则是创作决策的切身罗盘。

people.tiZh: tldraw 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Steve Ruiz is the founder and CEO of tldraw, the London-based startup behind a widely used infinite-canvas SDK for the web that powers products at Shopify, Google, Autodesk and many AI apps. A former fine artist turned design engineer, he created the viral "Make Real" demo that turns hand-drawn sketches into working code.
people.bioZh: Steve Ruiz 是 tldraw 的创始人兼 CEO,这家伦敦创业公司打造了被广泛使用的 Web 无限画布 SDK,支撑着 Shopify、Google、Autodesk 及大量 AI 应用。他从美术出身转做设计工程,打造了将手绘草图变成可运行代码的爆款 demo「Make Real」。

episodes.tEn: The Infinite Canvas: A Pivotal Interface for AI Collaboration

people.tiZh: Perplexity 设计副总裁
people.bioEn: Henry Modisett is the founding designer and VP of Design at Perplexity AI, leading product design, the creative studio, and design operations. A designer with a computer science background, he is known for designing in React rather than Figma, and previously held design roles at Quora and Google.
people.bioZh: Henry Modisett 是 Perplexity AI 的创始设计师兼设计副总裁,负责产品设计、创意工作室与设计运营。他拥有计算机科学背景,以直接用 React 而非 Figma 做设计著称,此前曾在 Quora 和 Google 担任设计职位。

episodes.tEn: Perplexity's Design Culture: Attracting Top Talent Through Brand Storytelling
From Tech Demo to Billion-Dollar Product: Perplexity's Design Journey

views.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

views.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns, and chase ROI rather than perfecting every surface.
views.zh: 2024 年，他反对在交互设计上创新，主张复用熟悉模式，并按投入产出比决定哪些界面值得做到极致。

views.en: Velocity at all costs: empower designers with ownership and clear decisions, shipping fast and iterating over perfection.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：速度至上，给设计师所有权与清晰决策权，快速发布、迭代而非追求完美。

views.en: Design becomes a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, not just decorate.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计深化为战略武器：创始人必须讲清设计如何帮公司取胜，而不只是做装饰。

views.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool: people join a brand, not a company, so invest in brand early to attract talent.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出品牌叙事是招聘工具：人们加入的是品牌而非公司，因此应尽早投资品牌以吸引人才。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 产品设计师
people.bioEn: Escha Vera is a product designer at Perplexity who led the design of Comet, the company's AI browser, building its onboarding, generative invite system, and design system from scratch. She is also an AI artist who trains her own image models and does music and operations for the record label N°ALIAE; she previously designed at Descript, Daylight Computer, and Detour.
people.bioZh: Escha Vera 是 Perplexity 的产品设计师,主导了该公司 AI 浏览器 Comet 的设计,从零构建了其新手引导、生成式邀请系统和设计系统。她同时也是一名 AI 艺术家,会训练自己的图像模型,并为唱片厂牌 N°ALIAE 负责音乐与运营;此前她曾在 Descript、Daylight Computer 和 Detour 担任设计师。

episodes.tEn: Designing Perplexity's AI Browser Comet from Scratch

people.tiZh: Perplexity 产品设计负责人
people.bioEn: Gunnar Gray is a multidisciplinary product designer and Product Design Lead at Perplexity, where he has shaped the company's mobile app and Voice Mode / dynamic voice experiences. Based in Minneapolis, he was previously a founding designer at Artifact (the AI news app by Instagram co-founders Kevin Systrom and Mike Krieger, later acquired by Yahoo) and a principal designer at MetaLab.
people.bioZh: Gunnar Gray 是一位多领域产品设计师,现任 Perplexity 产品设计负责人,主导了该公司移动应用及 Voice Mode(动态语音交互)体验的设计。他现居明尼阿波利斯,此前曾是 Artifact(由 Instagram 联合创始人 Kevin Systrom 与 Mike Krieger 打造、后被 Yahoo 收购的 AI 新闻应用)的创始设计师,并曾在 MetaLab 担任首席设计师。

episodes.tEn: Thriving as a Generalist Designer in the Age of AI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 产品设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ian Silber is Head of Product Design at OpenAI, where he has led design for ChatGPT and related products since August 2023. He was previously Director of Product Design at Instagram, and worked at Global Illumination and Artifact.
people.bioZh: Ian Silber 自 2023 年 8 月起担任 OpenAI 产品设计负责人,主导 ChatGPT 及相关产品的设计。他此前曾任 Instagram 产品设计总监,并在 Global Illumination 与 Artifact 工作。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Product Design with OpenAI's Head of Design
Designing with AI: Inside OpenAI's Product Design

views.en: Designers must work closely with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as the core design material rather than pixels.
views.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身紧密协作，把 token 和对话而非像素当作核心设计材料。

views.en: The model is the product; designers should prototype with live models and shift from mockups to system prompts and model behavior.
views.zh: 模型即产品；设计师应直接用真实模型做原型，从画稿转向系统提示词与模型行为。

views.en: Design roles blur with PM and engineering, yet specialized roles stay valuable at scale as designers become editors and curators.
views.zh: 设计角色与产品、工程边界模糊，但规模化下专业分工仍有价值，设计师转型为编辑与策展者。

views.en: AI is already a strong product designer, but humans remain essential for user understanding and a point of view.
views.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但理解用户需求与持有观点仍离不开人。

views.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate loop is no longer viable; speed, building in public and outcome focus replace process obsession.
views.zh: 旧的“原型—画稿—测试—迭代”流程已不可行，速度、公开构建与结果导向取代对流程的执念。

people.tiZh: 设计师 — Safari / Arc / Dia 浏览器
people.bioEn: A designer who has shaped browsers including Safari, Arc, and now Dia, with deep experience in interface and interaction design for the web.
people.bioZh: 资深设计师，参与塑造了 Safari、Arc，现在做 Dia 浏览器，在 Web 界面与交互设计上经验深厚。

episodes.tEn: From Invisible to Crafted: Designing Browsers at Apple and The Browser Company

people.tiEn: Research leader (Airbnb, Meta, Figma); AI builder & coach
people.tiZh: 研究负责人(Airbnb/Meta/Figma)；AI 构建者与教练
people.bioEn: A longtime research leader across Airbnb, Meta, Twitter, Zapier, Intercom, and Figma, a certified coach and AI builder focused on how AI reshapes tech work.
people.bioZh: 在 Airbnb、Meta、Twitter、Zapier、Intercom、Figma 长期担任研究负责人，认证教练与 AI 构建者，关注 AI 如何重塑科技行业的工作。

episodes.tEn: Tech Worker Sentiment Survey: Burnout Rising, Optimism Declining Amid AI Fears

people.tiEn: Head of Design, Claude Code & Cowork at Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Meaghan Choi is Head of Design for Claude Code and Cowork at Anthropic, where she leads the design of the company's developer and agentic AI products. A design and product leader with over a decade of experience, she previously worked at Meta and Cloudflare.
people.bioZh: Meaghan Choi 是 Anthropic 旗下 Claude Code 与 Cowork 的设计负责人,主导公司面向开发者及智能体 AI 产品的设计。她拥有十余年设计与产品经验,此前曾任职于 Meta 和 Cloudflare。

episodes.tEn: Designing Claude Code: A Designer's Journey at Anthropic

people.tiEn: Head of Product Design at Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic 产品设计负责人
people.bioEn: Joel Lewenstein is Head of Product Design at Anthropic, where he leads design for Claude and the company's API products. He previously led design teams at Airtable, Quora, Hustle, and GoodGuide.
people.bioZh: Joel Lewenstein 是 Anthropic 的产品设计负责人,主导 Claude 及公司 API 产品的设计。此前他曾在 Airtable、Quora、Hustle 和 GoodGuide 带领设计团队。

episodes.tEn: Designing at Anthropic: Joel Lewenstein on Navigating the AI Shift
Designing for AI's Present and Future

views.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase, and design work remains even if models stop improving.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作待解锁。

views.en: Designers must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts, and contribute to strategy.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续主张设计要兼顾降低新手门槛与抬高专家上限，并让设计师参与战略。

views.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；应相信缩放定律，让模型主导。

views.en: Ship light-touch products to unlock the model's power, with internal traction as the best signal for external shipping.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张以轻量产品释放模型能力，并把内部牵引力作为对外发布的最佳信号。

views.en: Production codebase becomes the source of truth; raw Claude Code beats polished tools, while human leadership handles hard trade-offs.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为生产代码库正成为事实来源，原始 Claude Code 胜过精修工具，而人类领导仍负责艰难权衡。

people.tiZh: Cursor（Anysphere）设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ryo Lu is Head of Design at Anysphere, the maker of the AI code editor Cursor, which he joined in early 2025. He was previously a founding designer and design lead at Notion, and earlier worked as a product designer at Stripe and Asana.
people.bioZh: Ryo Lu 是 AI 代码编辑器 Cursor 母公司 Anysphere 的设计负责人，于 2025 年初加入。他此前是 Notion 的创始设计师与设计主管，更早曾在 Stripe 和 Asana 担任产品设计师。

episodes.tEn: Cursor: AI-Powered Code Editor for Designers

people.tiEn: Founding Designer & Head of Design, Lovable
people.tiZh: Lovable 创始设计师兼设计负责人
people.bioEn: Nad Chishtie is the founding designer and head of design at Lovable, the AI app-building ("vibe-coding") startup, where he leads the design vision for a platform that lets anyone build apps by chatting with AI.
