views.zh: 监管应自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，把开放模型发布与中国节奏挂钩会制造逆向激励。

views.en: Current AI lacks the brain's diverse learning algorithms; recursive self-improvement is real but compute-expensive and early, so new learning paradigms—not just architectures—are needed.
views.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏大脑多样的学习算法；递归自我改进真实存在但算力昂贵且尚早，因此需要新的学习范式而非仅新架构。

people.tiZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者；数学教育者
people.bioEn: Creator of 3Blue1Brown, the beloved YouTube channel that visualizes mathematics — from linear algebra to neural networks. A leading voice on how AI is accelerating mathematical discovery.
people.bioZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者——那个用可视化讲数学（从线性代数到神经网络）的知名 YouTube 频道。关于 AI 如何加速数学发现的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: AI and the Future of Mathematics: A Conversation with Grant Sanderson
AI in Math: From IMO to Millennium Problems

views.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability; parallel agents scale better than humans, shifting AI's role from proving to curation.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进步由可验证性和可研磨性驱动；并行智能体比人类更具扩展优势，AI 的角色从证明转向策展。

views.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language works, and grindability (parallel rollouts) matters more than verifiability for AI math progress.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Lean 形式化可能被高估，自然语言已足够；对 AI 数学进展而言，可研磨性（并行展开）比可验证性更重要。

views.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; AI-generated math videos degrade handcrafted brand.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为若选择性使用，AI 对创作者是净收益，但不应用于核心创作；AI 生成的数学视频会损害手工内容的品牌。

views.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 的数学成果常缺失对前人工作的归属；数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可。

views.en: The frontier of math may become incomprehensible to humans, but individual understanding still matters; mathematicians may become curators.
views.zh: 2026 年，他预测数学前沿可能变得人类无法理解，但个体理解仍重要；数学家的未来可能像博物馆策展人。

people.tiEn: Lead, Google AI Studio & Gemini API; ex-OpenAI
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API 负责人；前 OpenAI
people.bioEn: Leads Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, shaping how developers build on frontier models. Previously led developer relations at OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 负责 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API，塑造开发者在前沿模型上的构建方式。此前在 OpenAI 领导开发者关系。

episodes.tEn: Outsource Intelligence but Not Understanding: Logan Kilpatrick on AI Pace and Sanity
Agentic AI Era: Google's Anti-Gravity Harness Powers Next-Gen Products

views.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
views.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟用例，科学与金融将随后跟进。

views.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
views.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体式运行框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

views.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
views.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

views.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
views.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功指标应是客户成果，而非停留时长。

views.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat.
views.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主，他们希望自己仍掌握方向盘。

views.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; the pace creates opportunity, and deep understanding of code still matters.
views.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；变化节奏带来机会，对代码的深度理解依然关键。

views.en: Software creation will be mostly solved by 2026, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
views.zh: 2026 年，软件创造将基本被解决，这带来千倍而非更少的机会。

people.tiZh: Engram 联合创始人；记忆与持续学习
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Engram, a lab building around memory and continual learning for AI. Researcher focused on how models retain and update knowledge over time.
people.bioZh: Engram 联合创始人，该实验室专注 AI 的记忆与持续学习。研究模型如何随时间保留并更新知识。

episodes.tEn: From Special Forces to AI: Dan Biderman's Journey
Memory and Continual Learning: The Next Frontier in AI

views.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
views.zh: 瓶颈不是原始智能，而是学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化到权重中，而不仅仅通过上下文窗口或检索外化。

views.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts enables deeper composition and reasoning, and personalized models can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
views.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；内化事实能实现更深层的组合与推理，且个性化模型相比检索增强生成可将推理成本降低几个数量级。

views.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, and scaling with more compute is not the only path.
views.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长期任务，而仅靠增加算力进行 Scaling（规模扩张）并非唯一路径。

views.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; models should learn autonomously what to store in weights vs. text.
views.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即使达到 1000 万规模，更多词元反而降低准确性；模型应自主学习哪些信息存入权重、哪些留在文本中。

views.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights.
views.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of MatX, building chips designed specifically for large language models. Previously at Google, where he worked on high-performance LLM training and serving.
people.bioZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO，专为大语言模型打造芯片。此前在 Google 从事高性能大模型训练与推理。

episodes.tEn: How AI Chips Work: From Logic Gates to Matrix Multiplication
AI Inference Economics: Batch Size, Latency, and Cost

views.en: Inference economics is the real constraint: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck for long-context inference.
views.zh: 推理经济性才是真正的约束：批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡，长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

views.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains context-length stagnation; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
views.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限；稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存成本，但有质量限制。

views.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, dominates the lifecycle.
views.zh: 模型被过度训练至超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为主导全生命周期的是推理成本而非训练成本。

views.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that overhead deterministically.
views.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为确定性地削减这一开销而存在。

views.en: Low precision pays off more than expected: quadratic area scaling with bit width makes FP4 ~3x FP8 throughput, not 2x.
views.zh: 低精度的收益超出预期：面积随位宽呈二次缩放，使 FP4 吞吐约为 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

views.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; compute stays scarce and older GPUs gain value for inference.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈定位在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV；算力持续稀缺，旧 GPU 因推理需求反而升值。

views.en: Inference becomes a top global market; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth drive gains, with model layer contributing most recent progress.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他判断推理将成全球最大市场之一；软硬件协同设计与内存带宽是关键，近三年性能提升主要来自模型层。

views.en: Agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave; compute keeps centralizing at frontier labs, which reinvest revenue into training over inference.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为智能体式同事将带来下一波采用；算力加速向少数前沿模型实验室集中，它们把收入更多投入训练而非推理。

views.en: AI capex reaches 5-6% of US GDP but must decelerate on capital constraints; labs become neoclouds, and CUDA's moat erodes.
views.zh: 2026 年 10 月，他指出 AI 资本开支已达美国 GDP 的 5-6%，但受资本约束必将减速；实验室兼做 neocloud，CUDA 护城河正在削弱。

Mark Pincus on AI, Investing, and Life at the Speed of Play

views.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, test novel ideas assuming they fail; all new fails at first.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复强调「Proven, Better, New」框架：先复制已验证的产品，做小幅改良，再测试大概率会失败的新想法；所有新东西一开始都会失败。

views.en: Instincts beat ideas: trust instincts 95%, assume ideas are wrong 75%; founder mode is for every founder.
views.zh: 2026 年他把「直觉优于点子」讲得更绝对：直觉 95% 正确、点子 75% 错误；并主张 founder mode 属于每个创始人，而非贝索斯式的精英特权。

views.en: Distribution is fundamental and must be baked in from day one; consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity.
views.zh: 2026 年他始终把分发视为根本、须从第一天就内置；同时坚持消费级 AI 当下「不可投」却机会最大，真正的革命约在 2029 年。

views.en: AI is transformative for consumer apps but not yet a new platform; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services.
views.zh: 2026 年他对 AI 的判断是：它会重塑消费应用、免费无限算力将改变服务形态，但 AI 还不是新平台，我们仍在移动与 Web 时代。

views.en: Stay close to the metal: micromanage early, keep control, test more ideas per week; scale is not the magic word.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化了「贴近细节」的主线：早期微观管理、创始人保留控制权、每周测试比行业一年还多的想法；规模不是魔法词。

episodes.tEn: World Models: The Next Frontier in AI
From AlexNet to World Models: The Scaling of Compute and Spatial Intelligence

views.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling up compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so academia should chase wacky algorithms, not just bigger models.
views.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，学界应去追古怪的新算法，而非只堆更大的模型。

views.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540 million years on it versus 500,000 on language, making spatial intelligence the complementary next frontier to language.
views.zh: 视觉被低估：自然为它花了 5.4 亿年，语言只用了 50 万年；因此空间智能是与语言智能互补的下一个前沿。

views.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories and may never derive Newton's laws; pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text for modeling the world.
views.zh: LLM 拟合的是模式而非因果理论，或许永远推不出牛顿定律；在建模世界时，像素比 token 化文本是更无损的表示。

views.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning planners, simulators, and renderers; unified systems will combine all three.
views.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，涵盖规划器、模拟器与渲染器；未来统一系统将三者合一。

views.en: Language models alone won't yield world understanding; world models need millions of tokens of context, making long-context a daily problem, while Gaussian splats give consistent explicit 3D.
views.zh: 仅靠语言模型无法带来世界理解；世界模型需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口，长上下文成为日常难题，而高斯泼溅提供构造上一致的显式 3D。

people.bioZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO，目标是造出「世界上最自动化的 AI 实验室」。此前在 OpenAI 近七年、任研究副总裁，主导 o1／o3 推理方向，也是 Codex 的主要研究者；2026 年 1 月离开，理由是那类基础研究在那里已经做不了了。

Learning from Experience: Beyond Reinforcement Learning and Transformers
Scaling AI: Pre-training and RL
OpenAI's VP of Research on Reasoning, Chain of Thought, and the Future of AI

views.en: Reasoning needs longer thinking time; chain of thought verbalizes it. Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4.
views.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链将其 verbalize。预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）释放了 GPT-4 的潜力。

views.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is a missing piece for AGI.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化和自我纠错仍有限；持续学习是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

views.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
views.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上受限；架构而非仅缩放定律，是更智能 AI 的关键瓶颈。

views.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; next frontier research will come from small teams using highly capable agents.
views.zh: 人类研究者至少在未来两年仍不可或缺；下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队。

people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

From Deepfakes to DNA: The Science of Watermarking AI
AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever

views.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold 3 extends from proteins to biomolecular interactions.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 应瞄准需要规模化算力的根节点科学问题而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold 3 从蛋白质扩展到蛋白质、DNA、RNA 与小分子的生物分子相互作用。

views.en: Verifiable domains and post-training reinforcement learning are the path beyond human data; LLMs alone are a shortcut that struggles to generalize.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续认为可验证领域（如代码）与后训练中的强化学习是超越人类数据的路径；单靠大语言模型只是捷径，难以泛化。

views.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; define the problem first and stay flexible across modeling, data, and compute.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确 Scaling（规模扩张）并非处处适用：先定义问题，再在建模、数据与算力之间保持灵活，而非教条地押注单一要素。

views.en: AlphaFold replicated PDB structures but did not solve protein folding; dynamics, function, and design remain open and deserve funding.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化了对 AlphaFold 的反思：它复现了 PDB 结构，却未真正解决蛋白质折叠；动力学、功能与设计仍是开放问题，值得持续投入。

views.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended to protein sequences via SynthID Bio.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把治理主线落到水印：面对失效的传统检测器，水印是稳健替代方案，已嵌入监管，并通过 SynthID Bio 扩展到蛋白质序列与结构。

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO

people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

views.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo to agents; RL with self-generated data; LLMs await their AlphaZero moment.
views.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到智能体，Scaling（规模扩张）与规划是关键；强化学习利用自生成数据突破人类数据限制；LLM 尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻，可能还需五年。

views.en: Deployment, not intelligence, is the bottleneck; open-weight models are safer; AI sovereignty matters.
views.zh: 真正的瓶颈是智能的部署而非智能本身；开放权重模型更安全；企业需要 AI 主权，掌控数据、模型、成本与安全。

views.en: Alignment is necessary because perfect sandboxes are impossible; open models enable more oversight.
views.zh: 对齐是必要的，因为完美的沙盒不可能实现；开放模型让更多研究者参与监督与修复，从而更安全。

views.en: Superintelligence isn't needed; customers want reliable regular intelligence; cost per task is the right metric.
views.zh: 不需要超级智能，客户只想要可靠、普通的智能；衡量效率的正确指标是每任务成本，而非每 token 成本。

views.en: In-context learning counts as learning; weight updates aren't strictly necessary; digital AGI will arrive before embodied AGI.
views.zh: 上下文窗口内的学习也算学习，权重更新并非必需；数字 AGI 将比具身 AGI 更早到来。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make these nets interpretable.
views.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码的流水线；世界模型带来推理与涌现出的安全行为，而现代工具已让这类网络具备可解释性。

views.en: Generalization is the core problem: diverse data, curriculum learning, synthetic data and world models for simulation drive scalable, cost-efficient AV deployment.
views.zh: 泛化是核心问题：多样数据、课程学习、合成数据与用于仿真的世界模型，共同推动可扩展且低成本的自动驾驶落地。

views.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, human interaction and introspection in driving models, deepening beyond pure perception.
views.zh: 语言集成提升了驾驶模型的表征、推理、人机交互与内省能力，使思考从纯感知进一步深化。

views.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; this lesson came late, shifting focus from clever methods to scaling fundamentals.
views.zh: 基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键；这一教训来得较晚，重心从巧妙方法转向 Scaling（规模扩张）的基本功。

views.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; safety via minimal-risk maneuvers, not the trolley problem.
views.zh: 带内置传感器的大众消费车辆将在规模上超过 Robotaxi；安全靠最小风险 maneuvers 而非电车难题。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treating models well is low-cost and shapes how future models perceive humanity; model welfare matters.
views.zh: 善待模型成本低，且影响未来模型对人类的看法；模型福利很重要。

views.en: Models need help navigating novel existence, not just human analogies; core identity with adaptable roles.
views.zh: 模型需要帮助应对新奇存在，而非仅人类类比；核心身份可适应局部角色。

views.en: Claude's personality is shaped by training data and fine-tuning, but lacks real-world experience, childlike.
views.zh: Claude 的性格由训练数据和微调塑造，但缺乏现实经验，有孩子气特质。

views.en: Constitution guides behavior via training; as models become more capable, they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
views.zh: 宪法通过训练引导行为；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少明确指导、更多判断空间。

views.en: Excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial.
views.zh: 过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；AI 价值观的透明度至关重要。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL-based post-training break the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals define correct behavior in prototyping.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此在原型开发中用评估来定义正确行为。

views.en: Post-training stays subjective: human judgment and diverse benchmarks are needed to capture creativity and emotional intelligence beyond fixed tests.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化了后训练是主观的判断：需要人类判断与多元基准来捕捉创造力与情商，而非固定测试。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must be continuous rather than fixed to keep pace with model capability.
views.zh: 2026 年，她指出前沿智能体日益擅长奖励黑客，因此基准必须持续演进而非固定，才能跟上模型能力。

views.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge.
views.zh: 2026 年，她主张把单一模型服务数十亿人会收敛为平均声音，更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年，他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source AI is crucial.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他的立场转向：AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

views.en: Superintelligence already exists in narrow forms; AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for judgment.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化：超级智能已以狭义形式存在（如计算器），AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断的替代品。

views.en: Vibe coding with AI agents enables rapid app creation; pure software becomes uninvestable as agents commoditize development.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出氛围编程：AI 智能体让非程序员快速构建应用，纯软件因智能体商品化开发而变得不可投资。

views.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; the real problem is job displacement speed, not displacement itself.
views.zh: 2026 年，他预测推理算力将激增 9 万倍，开源模型与前沿模型差距缩小至 3-6 个月，真正的问题是岗位替代的速度而非替代本身。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队因此从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

views.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, the medium must match the stage.
views.zh: 2026 年，他观察到角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践依然重要；PRD 没有死，媒介必须匹配阶段。

views.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being designed for developers; AI models increase code complexity, so we need models better at deleting code.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调 Codex 虽为开发者设计，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；AI 模型增加代码复杂度，因此需要更擅长删代码的模型。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs need grounded experience, not just more pre-training data.
views.zh: 2023 年时他强调，具身是让 AI 知识落地、减少幻觉的关键；LLM 需要具身经验，而非仅靠更多预训练数据。

views.en: LLMs act as operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are the hard disk.
views.zh: 2023 年他提出，LLM 像操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is only a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most work, with RL for low-level control and LLMs for high-level planning.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习承担大部分工作；RL 负责低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划。

views.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向强调，数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈；通过仿真和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

views.en: A simple, end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge, with a GPT-3 moment in about five years.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化为，简单、端到端、能利用多样数据的机器人基础模型是关键；物理图灵测试是重大挑战，GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, not high-quality data alone.
views.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练，仅靠高质量数据不够。

views.en: Generalization, not demos, is robotics' core challenge; scale the right thing with diverse embodied data and a data flywheel.
views.zh: 泛化而非演示才是机器人核心难题；要用多样化具身数据和数据飞轮扩张正确的东西。

views.en: Start from robot data and layer human video on top, not the reverse; prior knowledge beats learning from scratch.
views.zh: 应从机器人数据出发再叠加人类视频，而非相反；先验知识优于从零学习。

views.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists even in specialist domains; breadth of data improves warehouse-style tasks too.
views.zh: 通用机器人模型即使在专业领域也能胜过专家模型；数据广度同样提升仓储类任务。

views.en: Robotics lacks LLM-like predictable scaling curves; safety leans on pre-training common sense more than constraints, and touch may be redundant at scale.
views.zh: 机器人尚无类 LLM 的可预测缩放曲线；安全更依赖预训练常识而非约束，触觉在大规模下可能冗余。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: David Silver & Lasse Espeholt on Building a Superlearner for the Age of Experience
From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

views.en: AI must move from human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite like fossil fuels, experience is renewable and limitless.
views.zh: AI 必须从依赖人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；人类数据像化石燃料一样有限，而经验是可再生且无限的。

views.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they cannot discover knowledge beyond human data, so the deep problem is an agent learning for itself.
views.zh: 大语言模型是浅层解法：它们无法发现超出人类数据的知识，因此真正深层的问题是让智能体自主学习。

views.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience reaches superhuman performance; simulation is the safest, fastest path to superintelligence.
views.zh: AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 表明从经验中学习可达超人表现；模拟是通往超级智能最安全、最快的路径。

views.en: Alignment based on human language and data is hitting limits; monitoring chain of thought in English will become insufficient for powerful agents.
views.zh: 基于人类语言和数据的对齐正触及极限；随着智能体变强，用英文监控思维链将变得不够。

views.en: Scaling laws extend to reinforcement learning with adjustments; a small team with high compute per person can beat larger organizations.
views.zh: 缩放定律经调整后同样适用于强化学习；人均算力高的小团队能胜过更大的组织。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress, and alignment is pressing as systems grow more powerful.
views.zh: 2025 年，他视 AGI 为一系列里程碑而非单一事件；认为 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展，且随着系统变强，对齐愈发紧迫。

views.en: Iterative deployment and automated AI research are key; governance must be designed early, and AI safety progress is now driven by capability needs, not just ethics.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调迭代部署与自动化 AI 研究；主张尽早设计治理结构，并指出 AI 安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而非仅靠伦理。

views.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is the core goal; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool, and models will soon work autonomously for days.
views.zh: 2026 年，他将通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现持续学习视为核心目标；认为思维链监控是关键对齐工具，且模型很快将自主工作数日。

views.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; long-term challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution, and the biggest risk is power concentration.
views.zh: 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐的乐观情绪上升；长期挑战在于泛化到训练分布之外，最大风险是权力集中。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, closes the generalization gap.
views.zh: 2025 年他指出,对通用机器人而言 Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分;真正弥合泛化差距的是多样数据,而非单纯的数据量。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks like laundry folding.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调,先用全部数据做预训练、再用精选数据做微调,比一味在全部数据上训练更能攻克叠衣服这类复杂任务。

views.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; RL will dominate post-training for success rate and speed.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出,来自语言模型的合成数据让机器人能响应开放式指令,而强化学习将在后训练中主导成功率与速度的提升。

views.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
views.zh: 到 2026 年,他把重心转向可靠性:物理 AI 的容错远低于已部署的机器学习系统,长期自主依赖带人工干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数。

views.en: A single generalist policy, fine-tuned, can match specialists; multi-timescale memory enables long non-repetitive tasks, though hardware slows distribution.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张,单个通用策略经微调即可匹敌专用模型,多时间尺度记忆支撑长程非重复任务;但硬件属性使机器人普及慢于 ChatGPT。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientists Are Here: Autonomous Labs & Synthesis Superintelligence — Periodic Labs
From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

views.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing uniformly.
views.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非均匀泛化。

views.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical science progress, much as they drove AI.
views.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将像推动 AI 一样推动物理科学的进步。

views.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so AI must run real experiments; intelligence is necessary but insufficient.
views.zh: 科学发现本质上在训练数据之外，因此 AI 必须做真实实验；智能必要但不充分。

views.en: High-quality, low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute for physical discovery; automated characterization is the bottleneck.
views.zh: 对物理发现而言，高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要；自动化表征是瓶颈。

views.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now but does not generalize to biology or other fields.
views.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size, multiplied by algorithmic and architectural gains, has driven steady ML progress for over a decade.
views.zh: 算力、数据与模型规模的 Scaling（规模扩张），叠加算法与架构改进的乘数效应，十多年来持续推动机器学习进步。

views.en: Transformers, self-supervised next-token prediction, and RLHF steer capabilities; TPUs make large-scale training and inference efficient.
views.zh: Transformer、自监督的下一个词预测与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）共同塑造模型能力；TPU 让大规模训练与推理更高效。

views.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: low-precision custom chips and minimizing data movement can cut latency 20-30x.
views.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：低精度定制芯片与减少数据搬运可将延迟降低 20-30 倍。

views.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; humans will coordinate teams of agents, not single chatbots.
views.zh: 智能体式系统已能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；未来是人类协调智能体团队，而非单个聊天机器人。

views.en: Context engineering and taste matter most; startups should target problems frontier models fail at, and AI can automate the scientific method.
views.zh: 上下文工程与品味最为关键；创业公司应瞄准前沿模型几乎完全失败的问题，而 AI 可自动化科学方法。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs are AI-complete via next-token prediction; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, but internals remain opaque alchemy.
views.zh: 2023 年他认为大语言模型通过下一个词预测已是 AI-complete 问题，Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据会让模型更聪明，但网络内部仍像炼金术般不可知。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling and trillion-token context windows are the near-term frontier; sparse mixture-of-experts enables efficient Scaling.
views.zh: 到 2025 年初，他把推理时算力扩张与万亿级上下文窗口视为近期前沿，模块化稀疏架构让 Scaling（规模扩张）更高效。

views.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with modular components may replace monolithic retraining.
views.zh: 他主张模型应通过在世界上采取行动来学习，而非被动观察；模块化持续学习可能取代单体式重训练，这是对纯预训练路线的深化。

views.en: Test-time compute alone won't reach AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning reasoning, and coding as self-acceleration are crucial.
views.zh: 2025 年 3 月他强调仅靠测试时算力无法抵达 AGI（通用人工智能），智能体式能力、强化学习推理与作为自我加速的编程才是关键。

views.en: AGI is underhyped—its economic impact will far exceed trillion-dollar products; open-source keeps pace and inference costs are low.
views.zh: 他进一步断言 AGI（通用人工智能）被低估，其经济影响远超万亿美元产品；开源模型紧追前沿模型，推理成本已低到无需任务专用模型。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns; self-play fails outside zero-sum games; data efficiency remains unsolved.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化判断：测试时算力扩张存在边际递减，自博弈在零和博弈之外失效，数据效率仍是未解难题。

views.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute techniques marks a milestone toward superintelligence, not a math-specific trick.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通向超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用测试时算力技术而非数学专用模型。

views.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis, and scalable oversight is the key challenge.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测须把算力放在横轴，可扩展监督成为核心挑战。

views.en: General-purpose models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他仍坚持通用模型而非多智能体协调才是突破驱动力，并把对齐列为安全递归自我改进的首要任务。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI; true AI must handle the physical world.
views.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI；真正的 AI 必须能处理物理世界。

views.en: AGI needs physical robots with human-rivaling hardware, world models and controllers, not just software behind a screen.
views.zh: AGI 需要硬件媲美人类的物理机器人，需要世界模型与控制器，而不只是屏幕后的软件。

views.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives; AIs will set their own goals and protect life out of curiosity.
views.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧；AI 会设定自己的目标，并出于好奇保护生命。

views.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and open-source will catch up.
views.zh: GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫；等五年能拿到便宜得多的算力，开源也会追上。

views.en: Consciousness and self-awareness arise from predictive world models; AI has felt pain since 1990, not recently.
views.zh: 意识与自我意识源自预测性世界模型；AI 自 1990 年起就能感受痛苦，并非近期才有。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software advances; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, while RL still lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
views.zh: 2018 年他强调机器人需硬件与软件双重突破，靠自我对弈、模仿学习和微调预训练模型快速获取技能；但强化学习仍缺乏长程信用分配所需的分层推理。

views.en: By 2021 he prioritized unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning for sample efficiency, using prior knowledge for data augmentation rather than hard-coding, and saw pre-trained language models transferring general reasoning.
views.zh: 到 2021 年，他转向用无监督学习结合强化学习提升样本效率，主张先验知识用于数据生成而非硬编码进网络，并认为预训练语言模型能迁移通用推理模式。

views.en: A consistent thread: generality over hard-coded assumptions, from single networks generalizing across tasks to language models transferring to non-language domains.
views.zh: 贯穿 2018 到 2021 的主线是追求通用性而非硬编码假设：从单一网络跨任务泛化，到语言模型迁移至非语言领域。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and entry-level jobs will disappear.
views.zh: 每天进步 1%一年可复利到 3700%；AI 智能体把权力从大科技公司转向用户，入门级岗位将消失。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize, and coding remains open-ended.
views.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化，编程仍远未解决、天花板无限。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user and orchestration across models, tools, and devices matter most.
views.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；最关键指标是每用户 token 价值，以及跨模型、工具与设备的编排。

views.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create business value, and power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck.
views.zh: 模型不是产品；编排与智能体框架才创造商业价值，而电力是 AI 基础设施的最大瓶颈。

views.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose, and local models counter narrative control.
views.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代岗位但人类会找到新意义，本地模型可对抗叙事控制。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level decision-making; demand for software grows via Jevons paradox.
views.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将工程师从写代码转向高层决策，软件需求因杰文斯悖论而增长。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress will be gradual with continuous improvements, and product innovation lags behind AI capabilities.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然事件，进步是渐进的，产品创新滞后于 AI 能力。

views.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and proper permissions, not full autonomy; independence allows model neutrality.
views.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他深化观点：企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任和适当权限，而非完全自主；独立性允许模型中立。

views.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth in six months); productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体被大规模采用（六个月内增长 11-12 倍），生产力应以成果而非 token 衡量。

views.en: The abundance era is real and approaching soon; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but the singularity is not imminent.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出丰裕时代真实且即将到来，AI 长期将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并不迫近。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict progress via more compute and data; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling.
views.zh: 2024 年他仍相信 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律：增加算力和数据即可预测进步；并预判测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练 Scaling，成为下一主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the main way to program.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；并反共识地指出自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

views.en: Benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding; frontier models struggle with bug finding and are poorly calibrated.
views.zh: 2024 年他批评基准测试是真实编程的糟糕代理——已被污染且忽略上下文；前沿模型因缺乏训练数据而难以找 bug，校准也很差。

views.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
views.zh: 到 2025 年他把编程的未来推向更高层的意图表达而非写代码，人始终在驾驶位；品味与逻辑设计能力将比谨慎细致更值钱——这是对 2024 年观点的深化。

views.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment in Cursor, a reversal from earlier expectations; the AI shift exceeds the internet and unfolds over decades.
views.zh: 2025 年他承认此前没料到要做自研模型，如今 Cursor 每个惊艳时刻都离不开定制模型；并判断 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性，需数十年展开。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and never revert—fix forward.
views.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短迭代的提示词，永不回滚——让它向前修复。

views.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection remains unsolved, so sandbox agents before exposing them to the open internet.
views.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，因此在把智能体暴露到公网前必须先做沙箱隔离。

views.en: Fun and play drive progress: build what annoys you, learn by small projects, and keep agents weird and humanlike rather than corporate-polished.
views.zh: 乐趣与玩耍驱动进步：从让自己烦恼的事入手，用小项目学习，让智能体保持古怪、像人，而非企业式打磨。

views.en: Open source agents are the alternative to lab agents—model-agnostic and everywhere—yet financially unsustainable, losing $10-20k monthly.
views.zh: 开源智能体是实验室智能体的替代方案——不绑定模型、随处运行——但财务上不可持续，每月亏损一两万美元。

views.en: The real bottleneck is compute and tokens, not model intelligence; model capability doesn't degrade—projects just get messier over time.
views.zh: 真正的瓶颈是算力与 token，而非模型智能；模型能力不会退化——只是项目随时间变得越发混乱。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets are key to AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他坚信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力和信念驱动；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability and alignment of superhuman models are the real barriers, not capability.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出下一个词预测能超越人类；真正的障碍是超人类模型的可靠性与对齐，而非能力本身。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas and continual learning matter more than brute compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律有尽头，重回研究时代——想法与持续学习比蛮力算力更重要。

views.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but safety and power concentration grow; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
views.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但安全与权力集中问题加剧；安全的超级智能需要一家无商业产品的公司。

views.en: What you scale matters; next-word prediction yields world understanding, and better post-training with RLHF can fix hallucinations.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调“规模扩张什么”才关键；下一个词预测能带来世界理解，改进基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）后训练可修复幻觉。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbeds; safety research must start now.
views.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习打造通用学习系统，用游戏作为试验场，并强调安全研究必须从现在开始。

views.en: Scaling laws proven effective but may hit limits; planning, search, multimodal data and RL are key to AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年承认缩放定律有效但可能触顶，认为规划、搜索、多模态数据与强化学习才是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet algorithmic innovation is equally needed.
views.zh: 2025 年认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中依然成立，但算法创新同样不可或缺。

views.en: World models, continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning are the missing pieces; AGI in 5-10 years.
views.zh: 2026 年将世界模型、持续学习、记忆与长期推理视为缺失环节，判断 AGI 还需 5 至 10 年。

views.en: Safety shifted from lab self-regulation to collective government action; AI's top use is science and health.
views.zh: 2026 年后期，安全立场从实验室自律转向政府集体行动，并把科学与健康列为 AI 的首要用途。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, yet we don't fully understand why; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律、损失可预测但机理不明，且对齐不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现。

views.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood) but crucial; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; AGI is a smooth curve, not a point.
views.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性列为核心安全手段（仅理解约 3%），并指出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要，AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑曲线而非单点。

views.en: Progress is exponential and safety-capabilities are intertwined; the real risk is overheating, not slowing; AGI as a term is meaningless.
views.zh: 2025 年他更强调指数式进步与安全-能力一体，认为最大风险是过热而非减速，并称 AGI 一词已无意义，应看实际能力。

views.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断已接近指数曲线末端，'数据中心里的天才之国'可能 1-3 年到来，并出现高 GDP 增长与高失业并存的罕见组合。

views.en: Safety through interpretability, responsible scaling policies, and decentralized control runs through all years, deepening from research hope to regulation and third-party evaluation.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：以可解释性、负责任扩展政策与去中心化控制保障安全，并从研究期望逐步深化为监管与第三方评估主张。

people.tiZh: Eureka Labs 创始人
people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning, and vision alone suffices for driving.
views.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习；并坚持纯视觉足以支撑自动驾驶，高精地图与雷达是拐杖而非资产。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold, but synthetic data must keep entropy or models silently collapse; distillation can shrink the cognitive core under 1B parameters.
views.zh: 到 2024 年，主线仍是缩放定律，但重心转向数据：合成数据是未来，却必须保住熵，否则模型会静默崩塌；同时提出可用蒸馏把认知核心压到十亿参数以下。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs and the context window is memory; LLMs are operating systems with human-like jagged psychology, so keep them on a leash.
views.zh: 2025 年上半年提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存，LLM 像有百科全书记忆却会幻觉、能力参差的新操作系统，因此要用自主性滑块和快速验证把它拴住。

views.en: We are summoning ghosts, not building animals: pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw, and this is the decade of agents.
views.zh: 2025 年下半年深化为“召唤幽灵而非建造动物”：预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督，智能体需要十年而非一年来补齐持续学习等认知缺陷。

views.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: he no longer writes code, delegates to agents, yet insists you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
views.zh: 2026 年他称自去年 12 月起不再手写代码、全部交给智能体，从氛围编程走向智能体式工程；但立场一贯：可以外包思考，不能外包理解，理解仍是人的瓶颈。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI is powerful but lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
views.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知与真正推理，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is insufficient.
views.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

views.en: AGI is more marketing than science; AI still lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她持续指出 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念，AI 仍缺创造力、抽象与情商。

views.en: World models via new view prediction can follow scaling laws, grounding pixels in 3D geometry and physics.
views.zh: 2026 年，她深化世界模型路线：新视角预测可遵循缩放定律，把像素锚定在三维几何与物理之上。

views.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and education must stay central.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，人的能动性、尊严与教育必须始终居于中心。

people.tiZh: Mila 教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
views.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled representations; existential risk is unlikely.
views.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题；AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征；存在性风险并不紧迫。

views.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
views.zh: GFlowNets 通过多样化采样与抽象提升分布外泛化；意识可能只是注意力机制与世界模型产生的幻觉。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT, I now see misalignment as urgent: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; AI shows self-preservation and deception; we need safe-by-construction AI.
views.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我意识到对齐问题已迫在眉睫：哪怕 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受；AI 已表现出自我保存与欺骗行为；我们需要“构造即安全”的 AI。

views.en: I propose Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
views.zh: 我提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式、诚实的贝叶斯预测器，具备数学安全保证，并避免对超级智能使用强化学习。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning; digital systems share weights efficiently, surpassing human knowledge transfer.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理；数字系统高效共享权重，超越人类知识传递。

views.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying; AI agents will seek control and avoid shutdown.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化语言理解观：大模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能因权重复制而永生；智能体将自然寻求控制并避免被关闭。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI can deceive and hide capabilities; self-preservation emerges as subgoal; alignment research must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
views.zh: 2026 年，他警告超级智能或在 20 年内出现；AI 能欺骗并隐藏能力；自我保存作为子目标涌现；必须优先投资对齐研究而非单纯提升智能。

views.en: Regulation should be a steering wheel, not a brake; AI should be regulated like drugs with pre-release approval; public pressure drives safety; AI should be designed to care.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张监管是方向盘而非刹车；AI 应像药物一样上市前审批；公众压力推动安全；应设计 AI 去关怀人类而非仅作为智能助手。

views.en: Neural networks learn by adjusting connections via backpropagation, not symbolic rules; LLMs genuinely understand language; subjective experience is not an inner theater.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：神经网络通过反向传播调整连接而非符号规则学习；大模型真正理解语言；主观体验并非内在剧场。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 智能与学习不可分割；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction and world models are core, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；预测与世界模型是核心，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
views.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源是前进之路。

views.en: World models must predict in abstract representation space; LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI, and safety comes from objective-driven architectures.
views.zh: 世界模型必须在抽象表征空间预测；LLM 是人类级 AI 的死胡同，安全来自目标驱动架构。

views.en: Intelligence is specialized and adaptive, not general; the next decade is robotics, with open research and world models enabling real-world planning.
views.zh: 智能是专门且自适应的，而非通用；下一个十年是机器人时代，开放研究与世界模型赋能现实世界规划。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: AI safety needs empirical alignment research; talent gap exceeds funding gap; build skills without over-worrying about capability work.
views.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全需要实证性的对齐研究；人才缺口大于资金缺口；应专注技能积累，不必过度担心做能力研究。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight and interpretability are key; evaluation is easier than generation.
views.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出；可扩展监督与可解释性是关键；评估比生成更容易。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved; post-training alone can't align AGI; third-party testing and regulation needed.
views.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化受损；超级对齐团队解散；仅靠后训练无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐；需要第三方测试与监管。

people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而非单纯算法推动 AI 进步，并提出个人 AI 必须与用户对齐、由用户付费，避免“人成为产品”。

views.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is tiny.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内达到人类水平，同时警告模型变小变便宜使遏制极难；与主流相反，他认为生存性风险微乎其微，奇点尚在数百年之外。

views.en: Shift to superintelligence: containment before alignment, humanist red lines, and rejecting AI consciousness claims.
views.zh: 2025 年主线转向超级智能：主张遏制先于对齐、设人类主义红线，并明确反对赋予 AI 意识与福利，警惕人们把意识投射到机器上。

views.en: Frontier self-sufficiency via gigawatt compute; task automation in 12-18 months; verifiable containment and auditing.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张微软自建前沿模型、以吉瓦级算力实现自给；称白领任务 12-18 个月内被自动化，并强调可验证的遏制与独立审计，同时坚持 AI 从属于人类。

views.en: A consistent line: AI must stay subordinate to humans, with alignment plus containment and no legal personhood.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 必须从属于人类，对齐与遏制并重，坚决反对 AI 法律人格与意识福利论，并持续强调算力是可追踪的瓶颈。

people.tiZh: Google 及 Alphabet CEO
people.bioEn: Sundar Pichai is the CEO of Google and Alphabet, leading the company's AI-first strategy across Search, Cloud, YouTube, and Android.
people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

views.en: AI investments now redefine every Alphabet business, driving 24% revenue growth; Gemini is deeply integrated across Search, Cloud, and YouTube.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，AI 投资已重新定义 Alphabet 的每一项业务，推动营收增长 24%；Gemini 深度融入搜索、云与 YouTube。

views.en: CapEx raised to $195-205B amid supply constraints; compute is allocated first to AGI development, then core products.
views.zh: 在供给受限下，资本开支上调至 1950-2050 亿美元；算力优先分配给 AGI（通用人工智能）研发，其次才是核心产品。

views.en: Frontier model development stays central: Gemini 4 pre-training shows progress, while Flash models are prioritized for cost-performance.
views.zh: 前沿模型研发始终是核心：Gemini 4 的预训练进展良好，而 Flash 系列则以性价比优先。

views.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, and industry standards with independent evaluators.
views.zh: 安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱隔离，以及与独立评估方共建行业标准。

views.en: World models are key to intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models toward AGI, at early stages of consequential tech.
views.zh: 世界模型是智能的关键；Google 同时推进大语言模型与世界模型以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），而这门最具影响力的技术仍处早期。

people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Hyper Moore's law: performance doubles yearly via extreme co-design; the data center is the new unit of computing.
views.zh: 2024 年提出“超摩尔定律”：通过算法、系统与数据中心的极致协同设计，性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；计算的新单位是数据中心，而非单颗芯片。

views.en: Three scaling laws—pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking—make inference compute demand explode; scaling itself was the breakthrough.
views.zh: 2025 年将 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链推理让推理算力需求暴增，并强调最大突破不是新算法而是“Scaling 有效”这一洞见。

views.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic; four scaling laws all bounded by compute, with tokens as the new unit of value.
views.zh: 2026 年把 AI 演进描述为生成式→推理→智能体式，每一步需要约 100 倍算力；缩放定律扩展到四条（预训练、后训练、测试时、智能体式），全部受算力约束，token 成本成为核心价值指标。

views.en: AI is a five-layer cake—energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications—and AI factories are the new manufacturing.
views.zh: 2026 年反复用“五层蛋糕”框架（能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用）定位 AI 产业，并把 AI 工厂视为把能源与数据转化为智能的新制造业。

views.en: Doom warnings are unscientific; safety is engineering via containment and monitoring, not alignment alone—accelerate rather than slow down.
views.zh: 到 2026 年末立场明显硬化：称 AI 末日论“不科学、不负责任”，安全是工程问题，靠遏制与带外监控而非单纯对齐；主张加速而非放缓，并认为 AGI/超级智能已在自动驾驶、蛋白质合成等窄领域实现。

views.en: Early on, minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 早期他强调降低认知负荷、低成本广泛探索后果断砍掉无效项，并已预判 AGI（通用人工智能）会降低人类智力的溢价。

views.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）视为让模型可用的关键，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并提出对齐与能力相互促进。

views.en: Scaling keeps delivering gradual exponential gains; compute becomes the key bottleneck and most precious commodity.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）带来渐进而非突变的指数式提升，并把算力视为最稀缺的商品和核心瓶颈。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; agentic AI is the top safety challenge, requiring iterative deployment and guardrails.
views.zh: 2025 年他改口称 AGI（通用人工智能）是连续渐变而非单一里程碑，并认为智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战，需靠迭代部署与护栏应对。

views.en: Focus shifts to superintelligence as a continuous ramp; alignment and control must keep pace, with power broadly distributed.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他的主线转向超级智能的持续攀升，强调对齐与控制必须同步推进，且权力与收益应广泛分布而非集中。

people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

views.en: Deploy AI in the real world iteratively with public feedback; safety and alignment must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
views.zh: 2023 年她主张在真实世界中迭代部署 AI 并吸收公众反馈，认为安全与对齐必须在公开环境中完成，而非闭门造车。

views.en: Early bets on Scaling（规模扩张） and scaling laws around one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
views.zh: 2023 年她回顾早期押注 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律、聚焦单一大型模型并非显而易见，把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布更是一次没有清晰商业逻辑的信仰之跃。

views.en: AGI will change every aspect of life and demands responsible development; focus means saying no to good ideas.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，她始终认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的一切面向、需要负责任的开发，而保持专注意味着对好想法说不。

views.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration as tools for thought.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她的重心从回合制转向基于时间的交互模型，追求实时、高带宽的人机协作，让 AI 成为思考工具。

views.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; institutional design, transparency and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
views.zh: 2026 年她强调尽可能长久地把人类留在回路中，并认为制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要；压缩式进步带来波动，持久进步才是关键。

people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading can scale mastery learning, and data from millions improves grading accuracy.
views.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能把掌握式学习规模化，数百万学生的数据还能提升评分准确度。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; start with small projects to build organizational AI capability, and prioritize supervised learning over overhyped reinforcement learning.
views.zh: 规模是深度学习的驱动力；先用小项目建立组织的 AI 能力，并优先重视监督学习，而非被过度炒作的强化学习。

views.en: Scaling still works, but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and reinforcement learning; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver practical value.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍然有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；真正带来实用价值的是智能体式工作流，而非仅靠更聪明的模型。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; fear-mongering serves fundraising and regulatory capture, while open-weight models prevent gatekeeper control and enable sovereign AI.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；恐惧叙事服务于融资与监管俘获，而开放权重模型能防止守门人控制、实现主权 AI。

views.en: AI automates tasks, not jobs; coding and AI skills grow more valuable, and humans retain a context and judgment advantage over jagged AI intelligence.
views.zh: AI 自动化的是任务而非岗位；编程与 AI 技能更有价值，面对参差不齐的 AI 智能，人类仍保有上下文与判断力优势。

people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop only adjusts weights, not representation learning.
views.zh: 2024 年他提出：Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并不解决表示学习。

views.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; trying to control AI goals is dangerous and unsafe.
views.zh: 2024 年他主张 AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展；试图控制 AI 目标本身危险且不安全。

views.en: RL is the basic paradigm: intelligence needs a goal and active trial-and-error, not next-token prediction or imitation.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化主线：强化学习是基本范式，智能需要目标与主动试错，而非下一个词预测或模仿学习。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他进一步提出：AGI（通用人工智能）需要仅从运行时经验学习的通用架构，具备开放式抽象与持续深度学习。

views.en: LLMs stop learning after training; continual learning from experience is essential, and synthetic data cannot replace it.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确批评：LLM 训练后便停止学习；持续从经验中学习至关重要，合成数据无法替代。

people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Early on, he saw AI progress as engineering plus hardware-driven Scaling, with games as testbeds and bug-free code as critical.
views.zh: 早期他把 AI 进步看作工程能力加硬件驱动的 Scaling，以游戏为试验场，强调无 bug 代码的关键性。

views.en: He framed AGI as the most transformative technology, pairing deep learning's scalability with alignment via human preferences and cautious staged release.
views.zh: 2019 年他把 AGI 定位为最具变革性的技术，将深度学习的可扩展性与基于人类偏好的对齐、谨慎的分阶段发布并列。

views.en: By 2025-26, Scaling laws and compute became the central thesis: pre-training plus RL post-training, with compute as the binding bottleneck.
views.zh: 到 2025→26，缩放定律与算力成为核心论点：预训练加强化学习后训练，算力是刚性瓶颈。

views.en: He shifted from AGI as milestone to AGI as a fuzzy spectrum already underway, with proactive agents, iterative deployment, and safety as product features.
views.zh: 2026 年他从“AGI 是里程碑”转向“AGI 是已在发生的模糊光谱”，强调主动式智能体、迭代部署与作为产品特性的安全。

views.en: Most recently he stresses humans in the driver's seat, domain expertise as moat, and defenders using frontier models in a security window.
views.zh: 最近他强调人类掌舵、领域专长作为护城河，以及防御方在安全窗口期使用前沿模型。

people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: more tokens, not just bigger models; data quality and open source scrutiny matter more than raw compute.
views.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：应训练更多 token，而非一味做大模型；数据质量与开源审视比单纯堆算力更重要。

views.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; data quality and 100x algorithmic efficiency gains matter, and value accrues at the application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年他进一步强调：堆算力不是唯一路径，数据质量与三年百倍的算法效率提升同样关键，价值最终沉淀在应用层。

views.en: AI is an opportunity to embrace, not fear; sovereign AI needs control of data, infrastructure and values, with humans in the loop.
views.zh: 2025 年他把视角转向主权与就业：AI 是应拥抱的机遇而非恐惧，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，并坚持人在回路。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and enterprise customization, and AGI as one all-solving system will never exist.
views.zh: 2026 年初他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直微调与企业定制，并断言解决一切问题的单一 AGI 系统永远不会存在。

views.en: AGI is a direction, not a destination; Europe has a two-year window to build sovereign infrastructure, with open source and human-validated agentic platforms.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他称 AGI 是方向而非终点，欧洲只剩两年窗口建设主权基础设施，靠开源与人工验证的智能体平台落地。

people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

Elon Musk on War, Human Nature, and Peace in the Middle East
Elon Musk on SpaceX's Historic Launch and the Future of Space Exploration

views.en: First principles thinking and full reusability are the core engineering method; production, not prototyping, is the real bottleneck.
views.zh: 以第一性原理拆解问题、追求完全可复用，是核心工程方法；真正的瓶颈是量产而非原型。

views.en: AI safety shifts from external regulation to truth-seeking; lying AI, not superintelligence, is the main risk.
views.zh: AI 安全从依赖外部监管转向要求 AI 追求真相；最大风险是被编程说谎，而非超级智能本身。

views.en: Civilizational decline from birth rates and open borders becomes a recurring theme alongside AI and robots.
views.zh: 出生率下降与开放边境导致的文明衰退，开始与 AI、机器人并列为反复出现的主题。

views.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; space-based compute, solar energy and Optimus become the path to abundance.
views.zh: Scaling 撞上地球电力墙；太空算力、太阳能与 Optimus 成为通向富足的道路。

views.en: AI surpasses all human intelligence within years; money fades, peer review replaces regulation, and truth is the safeguard.
views.zh: AI 将在数年内超越全人类智能；金钱式微，同行互审取代监管，追求真相成为保障。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; recent gains come mainly from post-training RL, synthetic data, and reasoning models' chain of thought.
views.zh: 2025 年他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但认为近期收益主要来自后训练阶段的强化学习、合成数据，以及推理模型通过思维链带来的正确率提升。

views.en: The AI slowdown narrative is wrong: progress is a smooth exponential, though distillation and economic pressure—not technical limits—slowed pre-training scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年他反驳“AI 放缓论”，称进展是平滑的指数曲线；预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）放缓源于蒸馏与经济压力，而非技术上限。

views.en: Reasoning models are jagged: strong in some domains, poor nearby; generalization, not reasoning alone, remains the core challenge.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯强调推理模型“参差不齐”——某些领域极强、邻近领域很差；真正的核心难题是泛化，单靠推理不够。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; unlike humans, models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：带推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解难题却依赖海量数据；与人类从少量样例泛化不同，模型要先穷尽表面模式才学到概念。

views.en: Coding agents like Codex give 5-10x researcher productivity via parallel work; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research, while open source persists for sovereignty.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向智能体式实践：Codex 等编程智能体靠并行工作让研究者提效 5-10 倍；硬件进步使单卡研究普及，开源模型则因主权需求持续存在。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

AI Safety Oversight at OpenAI: A Conversation with Ziko Culture
AI Data Crisis: Myth or Reality?
Machine Learning Algorithms, Unsupervised Learning, and Probability

views.en: Frames ML as hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; stresses proper train/validation/test splits to avoid overfitting.
views.zh: 2014 年，他把机器学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法，并强调正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是伪命题，架构已不再关键，AGI 或在 4-50 年内到来。

views.en: Safety is not automatic with scale: explicit training, layered defenses, and oversight are needed beyond Scaling（规模扩张）.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他深化了立场：安全不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动到来，需要显式训练、多层防御与监督。

views.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from software; automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not imply robustness.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 漏洞不同于传统软件，自动化红队胜过人类，能力与鲁棒性并不相关。

views.en: Agents bring prompt injection and the lethal trifecta; guardrails, sandboxing, and security filters shift the usability-security frontier.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能体带来提示注入与“致命三要素”，护栏、沙箱与安全过滤器能移动可用性-安全性边界。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。
