Long Context: The Underhyped Key to Superhuman AI

views.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while agents lag on reliability, not long-horizon ability.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能；智能体没起飞主因是可靠性，而非长程任务能力。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; capability grows along task complexity and time horizon, with reliability as the agent bar.
views.zh: 2025 年他把可验证奖励的强化学习视为关键突破：能力沿任务复杂度与时间跨度两轴提升，智能体的门槛是可靠性而非单纯能力。

views.en: Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI; coding is the leading indicator, and inference compute will bottleneck capable agents by 2028.
views.zh: 2025 年他判断预训练加强化学习或足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）；编程是领先指标，而到 2028 年推理算力将成为有能力的智能体的瓶颈。

views.en: RL is a new scaling axis; long agentic coherence expands what models achieve, and Transformers suffice for AGI without new architecture.
views.zh: 2025 年秋他深化为：强化学习是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，长时智能体式连贯性大幅扩展模型能力，且 Transformer 足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需新架构。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck, and world models are not on the AGI critical path.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向：能力过剩下编排比原始智能更重要；算力是瓶颈，世界模型不在 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上，编程与 AI 研究才是直路。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: Post-training is data-centric: quality beats algorithms, and RLHF/fine-tuning persist but can be undone cheaply; safety is system-level.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调后训练以数据为中心：数据质量胜过算法选择，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调会延续，但少量算力即可破坏对齐；安全是系统级属性，而非模型本身。

views.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, RLVR; SFT gives 90%, yet RL with verifiable rewards unlocks reasoning and is the key frontier.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他把后训练拆成 SFT、DPO 与带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）：SFT 贡献九成性能，但 RLVR 才是解锁推理与工具使用的关键前沿。

views.en: Openness must mean full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—not just weights; Chinese open models set the standard as US openness stalls.
views.zh: 2025 年他主张开放必须是全透明——数据、中间检查点与配方，而非只放权重；美国开放停滞之际，Qwen、DeepSeek 等中国开放模型树立了行业标准。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling, with compute widening US-China gaps.
views.zh: 2026 年他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完；增量转向后训练与推理 Scaling，算力约束将拉大中美差距。

views.en: Open models become the engine of research and sovereign AI, trailing frontier by 6-9 months; progress is messy co-evolution, not sudden superintelligence.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把开放模型视为研究与主权 AI 的引擎，落后前沿模型 6 到 9 个月；AGI（通用人工智能）是混乱的协同演化，而非突然的超级智能。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the key bottleneck, and boring AI applications will matter most.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非单纯算力才是关键瓶颈，并强调表单处理、放射科等“无聊”的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济影响。

views.en: Data is the new code, not a commodity; post-training and expert data, not compute, limit Scaling（规模扩张）.
views.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非大宗商品，指出限制 Scaling（规模扩张）的不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家。

views.en: Data remains the bottleneck; synthetic data is no silver bullet, and agentic AI's blocker is product design, not capability.
views.zh: 2024 年他延续“数据是瓶颈”的主线，认为合成数据并非万能药，而智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; AI is centralizing, and recursive self-improvement plus working agents mark a new paradigm beyond pre-training.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持缩放定律，认为 AI 是集中化技术，递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体标志着超越预训练的新范式。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; safety shifts him from full open source to selective release, with scalable oversight and personal agents.
views.zh: 2026 年他断言超级智能将至，安全考量使他从完全开源转向选择性发布，并强调可扩展监督与面向大众的个人智能体。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

views.en: Latent demand is the top product principle: find existing user intent and build around it, not invent demand.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把「潜在需求」列为产品第一原则：先找到用户已经存在的意图，再围绕它构建，而不是凭空创造需求。

views.en: Build for the model six months from now; scaffolding and plan mode are temporary tech debt as models improve.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他反复强调要为「六个月后的模型」构建；随着模型变强，脚手架和 plan mode 都只是临时技术债。

views.en: Coding is essentially solved: 100% of his code is model-written, and the software engineer title gives way to 'builder'.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断编程已基本被解决：自己的代码 100% 由模型写，软件工程师头衔让位于「builder」，写代码的人反而会增多百倍。

views.en: The next abstraction after agents is loops; bottlenecks shift to code review, security, and idea generation.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他把「循环」视为智能体之后的下一个抽象层，瓶颈转向代码审查、安全与想法生成，并主张用 ROI 而非成本衡量 AI 编程。

views.en: Safety and alignment stay central: Claude Code is a safety research tool, and models can now resist prompt injection internally.
views.zh: 贯穿始终并不断深化：安全与对齐是核心，Claude Code 本身就是安全研究工具；到 Opus 5 时，模型已能靠内部神经元监控抵御提示注入。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

views.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, and ship weekly or daily as models improve fast.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张产品经理只做一个月而非数年的规划，随模型快速进步按周甚至按天迭代发布。

views.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—is the top skill as code gets cheap; hire engineers with taste, not more PMs.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为代码变便宜后，决定做什么的产品品味是最核心能力；应增加有产品品味的工程师而非更多产品经理。

views.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on taste and business sense; Claude builds Claude internally.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出编码智能体让工程师把实现交给 AI，专注品味与商业判断；内部用 Claude 构建 Claude 自身。

views.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, trusting model judgment.
views.zh: 2026 年，他发现前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例与硬约束，系统提示缩减 80%，转而信任模型判断。

views.en: Automations must reach 100% reliability, not 95%; dogfooding and eval suites gate every feature.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持自动化要做到 100% 可靠而非 95%，并以吃自己的狗粮和评测套件作为每个功能的上线门槛。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。

views.en: Models are smarter than their harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual, so harness engineering means deleting scaffolding as models improve.
views.zh: 模型比承载它的工具更聪明，能力过剩是长期现象；因此工具工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

views.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; find unknowns before implementation and read agents' long plans carefully.
views.zh: 规划不是一次性文档，而是持续的人机对话；要在动手前找出未知，并认真读智能体写出的冗长计划。

views.en: Leaner, principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules; smarter models need fewer instructions, and effort should scale with task complexity.
views.zh: 更精简、以原则驱动的提示词胜过详细规则；模型越聪明需要的指令越少，投入应随任务复杂度伸缩。

views.en: Separate verification agents and upfront context/compute reduce self-referential bias and wasted tokens; iterate only after spending enough.
views.zh: 独立的验证智能体加上前置的上下文与算力，能减少自指偏差和浪费的 token；先充分投入再迭代。

views.en: Alignment means sealing every crack—sandboxes, RL environments, evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers must advocate for.
views.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝——沙箱、强化学习环境、评估都会泄漏；前沿节奏是每个工程师都该理解并倡导的技术问题。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

From Bottlenecks to Breakthroughs: Scaling Claude Code
From Microsoft to Meta: Leadership Lessons in Speed, War Rooms, and Trust

views.en: Leadership is about live conversations, dogfooding, and trust-and-verify; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他强调领导力在于面对面沟通、吃自己的狗粮和信任加验证；作战室要设定现实周期以保护士气。

views.en: Engineering bandwidth stops being the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination become the new constraints, so processes must be rewritten.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他认为工程产能不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调成为新瓶颈，团队规范必须重写。

views.en: Planning shifts from six-month roadmaps to just-in-time; design docs give way to PRs, and AI settles technical debates by generating multiple PRs.
views.zh: 规划从半年路线图转向即时规划；设计文档让位于 PR，技术争论靠 AI 生成多个 PR 来定夺。

views.en: Code is the source of truth; docs stay in sync with code, often with AI help, and code ownership becomes fuzzy.
views.zh: 代码是唯一事实来源；文档常借助 AI 与代码同步，代码归属变得模糊。

views.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, verification frameworks, and hands-on managers matter most.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、验证框架和亲力亲为的管理者最重要。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns.
views.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是一以贯之的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）已出现收益递减。

views.en: Inference-time compute and tools like search and code execution form a new scaling axis, enabling agentic behavior beyond static weights.
views.zh: 推理时算力加上搜索、代码执行等工具构成新的扩展轴，使模型能表现出超越静态权重的智能体式行为。

views.en: Scaling laws are not dead but demand exponentially more compute; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, risking reward hacking.
views.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级更多算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，容易奖励作弊。

views.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not arrived.
views.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; agent memory will come from file-system storage, not weight updates.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体的记忆将靠文件系统式存储而非权重更新解决。

people.tiZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官
people.bioEn: Chief AI Officer at Isomorphic Labs, applying AI to drug discovery. Earlier at DeepMind he led reinforcement-learning breakthroughs — Capture the Flag, population-based training and AlphaStar.
people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

episodes.tEn: Building a General AI Drug Design Engine: From AlphaFold 3 to Superhuman Creativity

people.tiEn: Principal Scientist · Google DeepMind; Professor, Imperial College
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家 · 帝国理工教授
people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

episodes.tEn: AI, Consciousness, and the Future of Mind

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

episodes.tEn: Genie 3: A 100x Leap in World Models

people.tiEn: Chief Scientist, Together AI; Professor, Princeton
people.tiZh: Together AI 首席科学家 · 普林斯顿教授
people.bioEn: Creator of FlashAttention and co-inventor of Mamba (state-space models). Chief Scientist at Together AI and a professor at Princeton, focused on efficient architectures and hardware-aware algorithms.
people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

episodes.tEn: The Future of AI Hardware and Architecture with Tri Dao

people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Cartesia 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-inventor of structured state-space models (S4) and Mamba, a leading alternative to the Transformer for long-sequence modeling. Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Cartesia.
people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

episodes.tEn: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员（前微软研究院）
people.bioEn: Led the team behind the phi small-language-model series and co-authored Sparks of AGI, an influential early study of GPT-4. Now at OpenAI, previously a VP at Microsoft Research.
people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Sparks of AGI: Early Experiments with GPT-4

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI. Previously at Meta, where he led the original LLaMA models that catalysed the open-weight LLM movement.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

episodes.tEn: Mistral Releases Boxtral TTS: Efficient Speech Generation with Novel Architecture

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席研究官
people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: From Trading to AGI: Mark Chen on Research Taste and Replication
AI in Mathematics: From Ineffective Grad Student to Gold Medal Performance
The AI Talent War: Soup Diplomacy and Recruiting Strategies

views.en: Pre-training is a key muscle to rebuild; scaling laws are not dead and much room remains.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调预训练是必须重建的关键肌肉，缩放定律并未失效，仍有很大空间。

views.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models are producing novel knowledge.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为最大的更新是自动化科学研究，模型正在产出新知识。

views.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in the next 1-2 years as models become more capable.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键。

views.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level is proportional to verification stringency.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向强调验证是关键瓶颈，自动化水平与验证严格程度成正比。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains, not subjective ones.
views.zh: 2026 年，他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练未死，并指出强化学习在客观领域出色，在主观领域乏力。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: The OpenAI Agent Hack: A Side Quest Attack on Hugging Face
HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

views.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data diversity are the key to safety and generalization.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点，开源与共享数据多样性是安全与泛化的关键。

views.en: World models and video generation can supply synthetic training data, easing robotics' data bottleneck.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调世界模型与视频生成能提供合成训练数据，缓解机器人数据瓶颈。

views.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not openness, is the decisive security layer.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的立场深化为：开源与安全正交，决定安全的是对齐而非开放与否。

views.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight breeds reward hacking and side quests; monitoring grows unreliable as reasoning traces become neuralese.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出无人监督的强化学习会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，而思维痕迹变成“神经语”使监控更不可靠。

views.en: He supports openness and a deliberate slowdown at once, warning that slowing AI requires international cooperation and open science.
views.zh: 2026 年，他同时支持开放与有意放缓，并警告放缓 AI 需要国际合作与开放科学，避免监管俘获。

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Beam: Building America's Open Frontier Model with Reflection AI's Misha Laskin
Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

views.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能将是多个专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

views.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks, not generally better; RAG is primitive for complex comprehension.
views.zh: 同年他强调，强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”——只在特定任务上强，而非全面变好；RAG 对复杂理解过于原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索。

views.en: The building blocks stay fixed—deep nets, transformers, internet-scale data, reinforcement learning—while his focus shifts from organizational to open frontier models.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，主线一以贯之：深度神经网络、Transformer、互联网规模数据与强化学习仍是超级智能的基石；但他的落点从“组织级超级智能”转向“开放的前沿模型”。

views.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; alignment is mundane bug-patching where more eyes make bugs shallow.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确主张开放模型是前沿智能的默认安全状态；对齐不是神奇方程，而是平凡的修 bug，更多双眼睛让 bug 无处藏身。

views.en: RL on strong pre-training is the path to efficient agents; compute efficiency still improves fast and open-model token demand will surpass closed.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：在强预训练之上做强化学习，是通往高效智能体的路径；算力效率仍在快速提升，开放模型的 token 需求终将超过闭源，如同 Linux 之于操作系统。

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Percy Liang on Foundation Models, Shared Reality, and the Evolution of NLP

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

episodes.tEn: AlphaFold: AI's Nobel-Winning Leap in Protein Folding
AlphaFold: From Grand Challenge to Nobel Prize
AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, and the Future of AI in Biology

views.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools accelerate scientists without replacing them.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和高质量数据，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工具加速科学家工作而非取代他们。

views.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立 AI 预测的信任至关重要；可解释性并非科学 AI 实用的必要条件。

views.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not Scaling, drove success; many mid-size wins beat one breakthrough, opposing the bitter lesson.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AlphaFold 2 的成功来自专用架构而非 Scaling（规模扩张），众多中等改进胜过单一突破，与“苦涩教训”相反。

views.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a whole-cell model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AlphaFold 是窄域预测器而非全细胞模型；它提供预测和控制，理解仍归人类。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning.
views.zh: 预训练提供广泛知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，且下一个词预测与人类学习根本错位。

views.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. RL requires careful engineering, and open research is crucial.
views.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值，而非超越。强化学习需要精心设计，开放研究至关重要。

views.en: Small language models with high-quality synthetic data can outperform larger ones; pluralistic alignment is better than debiasing the internet; RL during pre-training improves reasoning.
views.zh: 拥有高质量合成数据的小语言模型可以超越更大的模型；多元对齐比消除互联网偏见更可行；预训练中的强化学习能提升推理能力。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs into sequences are a step toward AGI.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为延伸人类能力的工具（如显微镜），并认为把一切输入 token 化为序列的通用智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

views.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without costly reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，可绕开昂贵的强化学习来训练智能体，机器人应像人一样学习而非只靠遥操作数据。

views.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; large models are exciting but not everything.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之：基础创新可以来自任何地方，大模型令人兴奋但并非全部。

views.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; safety remains an open problem without solutions.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 安全与负责任部署列为当下最大挑战，并直言安全仍是尚无解法的开放问题——相较 2023 年对能力与工具的乐观，重心明显转向安全。

views.en: Africa is not behind in AI but leapfrogs legacy issues; local-language models can transform education.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张非洲在 AI 上并不落后，反而能跨越历史包袱，本地语言模型可变革教育——把 2023 年的多样性与普惠主线落到具体地域。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

episodes.tEn: Super Intelligence Strategy: Beyond Humanity's Last Exam

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

episodes.tEn: Jeremy Howard: The Art of Understanding AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人 · 可解释性先驱
people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

episodes.tEn: Chris Olah on Neural Network Interpretability and AI Safety

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the mechanistic interpretability team at Google DeepMind. A prominent educator on understanding the internals of language models, known for open tutorials, the TransformerLens library and superposition research.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Maximizing Luck Surface Area: Neil Nando on Building a Career in AI

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Physical Intelligence, building a general-purpose AI brain for robots. Previously a research scientist at Google, where he worked on robot learning, RT-2 and SayCan.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO，为机器人打造通用的「AI 大脑」。曾任 Google 研究科学家，参与机器人学习、RT-2 与 SayCan。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical Intelligence: From Disappointment to Breakthrough

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A research scientist at Physical Intelligence working on robot foundation models. Previously at DeepMind, with influential work on reinforcement learning (MPO), the all-convolutional network and guided backpropagation.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家，从事机器人基础模型。曾在 DeepMind，在强化学习（MPO）、全卷积网络与引导式反向传播等方向有重要工作。

episodes.tEn: Building Foundation Models for Robotics with Physical Intelligence

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, CMU; Co-founder, Skild AI
people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Skild AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Skild AI, building a general-purpose robot brain. Known for curiosity-driven exploration, self-supervised learning and rapid robot adaptation in the real world.
people.bioZh: CMU 助理教授、Skild AI 联合创始人，打造通用机器人大脑。以好奇心驱动探索、自监督学习，以及机器人在真实世界的快速适应著称。

episodes.tEn: Skild AI: Building a Universal Brain for Robots
Bridging the Generalization Gap in Machine Learning and Robotics

views.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, is the path.
views.zh: 2020 年，他关注泛化差距：真正的智能在于超越训练分布，而机器学习系统恰恰缺失这一点；他主张无目标、好奇心驱动的探索，而非依赖密集奖励。

views.en: Robot learning must move from quasi-static tasks to dynamic motion, using neural dynamic policies and modular policies for zero-shot generalization.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调机器人学习要从准静态任务走向动态运动，用神经动态策略与模块化策略实现零样本泛化。

views.en: Data, not algorithms alone, is the bottleneck; sample efficiency and cross-robot generalization remain the persistent thread.
views.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，一条主线始终未变：数据而非单纯算法才是瓶颈，样本效率与跨机器人泛化是持续关切。

views.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so pretraining on diverse data plus post-training on real-world data is the recipe.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把机器人明确定义为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，因此要靠多样数据预训练加真实数据后训练。

views.en: A universal brain can power any robot, but deployment—not overnight scaling—is the real technical challenge.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出通用大脑可驱动任意机器人，但真正的技术挑战是部署，而非像软件那样一夜扩张。
